blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Embodied intelligence aims to let robots perform complex physical tasks with human-like adaptability and reliability, which requires three complementary capabilities: history-based cognitive reasoning, precise and timely physical execution, and the composition of reasoning and execution through environmental feedback. Yet existing benchmarks either evaluate reasoning and execution within the same tasks or assess them separately without their composition, so they reveal little about whether a failure comes from reasoning, execution, or their composition. We introduce Mind2Act World, a diagnostic benchmark of 30 simulated manipulation tasks from five real-world application domains. Each task has three difficulty levels and two scene settings (Clean and Random), yielding 180 configurations. The tasks form three views: Mind tests decisions based on past observations, Act tests precise and timely execution, and Mind2Act combines both in closed-loop tasks where action outcomes guide later decisions. Comparing the three views shows whether a system lacks a capability or fails to compose capabilities it already has. A diagnosis harness further attributes the failed episodes of three representative systems to Mind, Act, or their composition and summarizes each system in a profile card. Our evaluation of multimodal agents, vision-language-action models (VLAs), and world-action models (WAMs) shows that competence in a single view does not carry over to Mind2Act tasks. Even the strongest agent succeeds in 52.7% of Mind and 39.0% of Act episodes but in only 12.0% of Mind2Act episodes. The strongest agent retains task state but struggles with sustained contact, whereas end-to-end policies execute practiced motions but retain little task state. These findings point to composing reasoning and execution through environmental feedback as the main open problem.
blocks.zh: 健美的智能旨在让机器人以人类般的适应性和可靠性执行复杂的物理任务,这需要三种互补能力:基于历史的认知推理,精确和及时的物理执行,以及通过环境反馈的推理和执行的构成. 然而,现有的基准要么是在相同的任务范围内评估推理和执行,要么在没有组成的情况下单独评估,因此它们很少揭示失败是来自推理、执行还是组成。 我们引入了Mind2Act World, 由来自五个现实世界应用领域的30个模拟操纵任务的诊断基准. 每个任务有三个难度级别和两个场景设置(Clean and Random),产生180个配置. 任务形成三种观点: 基于过去观察的思维测试决定,法案测试精确和及时的执行,以及Mind2 Act结合了闭路任务中的行动结果指导后来的决定. 比较这三种观点可以发现,一个系统是否缺乏能力,还是未能形成它已经具备的能力。 一种诊断方法进一步将三个代表性系统的失败事件归结为Mind, Act, 或其组成,并在一个剖面卡中总结每个系统. 我们对多式联运代理商、视觉-语言-行动模式(VLA)和世界-行动模式(WAMS)的评价表明,单凭一种观点,能力不会延伸到Mind2Act的任务。 即使最强的药剂在Mind的52.7%和Act的39.0%中都成功,但在Mind2Act的12.0%中也成功。 最强的推动者保留任务状态,但与持续接触挣扎,而端对端政策则执行实践动议,但任务状态很少。 这些调查结果指出,通过环境反馈来形成推理和执行是主要的公开问题。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: “Knowledge is the beginning of action and action is the completion of knowledge.” — Wang Yangming
blocks.zh: "知识是行动的开始,行动就是知识的完成"——王阳明.

blocks.en: The central ambition of embodied intelligence is to enable robots to perform complex physical tasks with human-like adaptability and reliability. Studies of human sensorimotor control indicate that adaptive and reliable manipulation involves reasoning over task-relevant information, executing physical actions precisely, and adapting behavior through environmental feedback [ 1 , 2 , 3 ] . In the cooking task of Fig. , a robot must remember which ingredient to add next , coordinate both arms to add the ingredient , and switch the stove from heating to keep-warm mode based on temperature feedback . These requirements motivate three capabilities. Mind decides what to do from earlier observations. Act produces the required physical effect in time. Mind-Action Composition closes the loop, so that remembered information guides each action and each physical outcome updates the next decision.
blocks.zh: 所体现智能的中心雄心是使机器人能够以人类般的适应性和可靠性来完成复杂的物理任务. 对人类感官控制的研究显示,适应性和可靠的操纵涉及对任务相关信息的推理,精确地执行物理动作,以及通过环境反馈调整行为[1,2,3]. 在Fig.的烹饪任务中,机器人必须记住下一步要添加的成分,协调两只手臂来添加成分,并且根据温度反馈将炉子从取暖改为保温模式. 这些要求激励了三种能力。 明德决定从更早的观察做起. 法案及时产生所需的实际效果。 Mind-Action Constitution 关闭了循环,这样记忆中的信息可以指导每个动作,每个物理结果可以更新下个决定.

blocks.en: Recent embodied systems spanning multimodal agents [ 32 ] , vision-language-action models (VLAs) [ 19 , 20 ] , world-action models (WAMs) [ 23 , 26 ] , and hybrid architectures [ 27 , 28 ] have substantially advanced robotic manipulation. However, their capabilities in Mind , Act , and Mind-Action Composition remain poorly understood, which makes it difficult to identify capability bottlenecks and guide further development. Two limitations of existing embodied benchmarks [ 4 , 6 , 7 , 8 , 12 ] explain why. First, conventional benchmarks often assess cognitive reasoning and physical execution within the same tasks and report only whether a task succeeds [ 4 , 5 , 6 ] , so a failure cannot be traced to Mind or Act . Second, although recent benchmarks have introduced finer-grained diagnostics and separate assessments of reasoning and physical execution [ 8 , 11 , 12 , 13 ] , they rarely evaluate Mind-Action Composition , particularly whether physical outcomes can effectively inform subsequent decisions. Closing this gap requires tasks that stress one capability while keeping the others present but easy, a judgment of composition based on verified physical outcomes, and a comparison of systems with different action interfaces and inference speeds on equal terms.
blocks.zh: 最近体现的涵盖多式联运代理人的系统[32]、愿景语言-行动模型[19、20]、世界行动模型[23、26]和混合结构[27、28]已大大推进了机器人操纵。 然而,它们的能力在Mind、Act和Mind-Action 组成方面仍然缺乏了解,因此难以查明能力瓶颈并指导进一步发展。 现有包含的基准[4、6、7、8、12]的两个局限性解释了原因。 第一,常规基准常常在同一任务范围内评估认知推理和物理执行,只报告一项任务是否成功[4,5,6],所以失败不能追溯到Mind或Act. 第二,虽然最近的基准引入了更精细的诊断和对推理和实体执行的单独评估[8、11、12、13],但它们很少评价 " 心灵行动 " 的构成,特别是物理结果能否有效地为随后的决定提供参考。 缩小这一差距需要强调一种能力,同时保持另一种能力,但易于实现的任务,需要根据经核实的物理结果判断组成,以及将系统与不同的行动界面和推论速度进行平等比较。

blocks.en: To this end, we introduce Mind2Act World , a diagnostic benchmark for Mind , Act , and Mind-Action Composition in robotic manipulation (Fig. ). Its 30 tasks come from five real-world application domains and are organized into three views of ten tasks each, covering 12 capability categories. Each view emphasizes one demand by design. Mind tasks keep physical operations simple, Act tasks state the required operation explicitly, and Mind2Act tasks chain dependent operations so that each physical outcome decides what comes next. Success is judged from physical predicates on the environment, and the evaluator records stages and events within each episode. Each task has three difficulty levels that raise its demands while keeping the objective fixed. Each level runs in a Clean and a Random scene, which share the same instance but differ in clutter, materials and lighting (180 configurations in total). Agents and end-to-end policies share the same tasks, information contract and evaluator, and 4,500 demonstrations (75.8 hours) are provided for fine-tuning end-to-end policies. A diagnosis harness combines rule-based analysis of the evaluator’s stage and event records with an LLM judge to attribute each failed episode of three representative systems to Mind , Act , or their composition. It summarizes each of these systems in a per-model report called a model profile card (Fig. 5 ; Appendix E.4 ).
blocks.zh: 为此,我们引入了Mind2Act World,这是Mind、Act和Mind-Action在机器人操纵中的构成(图)的诊断基准。 它的30个任务来自5个现实世界应用领域,分为3个观点,每个观点包含10个任务,涵盖12个能力类别. 每种观点都通过设计强调一种需求。 Mind任务使物理操作简单化,Act任务明确规定了所需的操作,而Mind2Act任务链依赖操作则由每个物理结果决定接下来会发生什么. 成功与否由环境物理上方判断,评价者记录每集的阶段和事件. 每项任务有三个难度层次,既能提高要求,又能保持目标固定. 每个关卡都运行在"干净"和"随机"的场景中,这些场景都具有相同的实例,但在杂质,材料和照明方面却有所不同(共计180个配置). 代理商和端到端政策分担相同的任务,信息合同和评价员,为细化端到端政策提供4500个示范(75.8小时). 一个诊断工具将基于规则的对评估者阶段和事件记录的分析与LLM法官结合起来,将三个代表系统失败的每集归结为Mind、Act或组成。 它在一份名为模型剖面卡(图5;附录E.4.)的每个模型报告中概述了这些系统。

blocks.en: Our evaluation on Mind2Act World reveals a clear pattern. Existing architectures are uneven across Mind and Act , yet all struggle with Mind-Action Composition . The strongest agent retains task state well but struggles to sustain contact, and its timed successes are measured with a simulator that pauses during inference. End-to-end policies respond within a fraction of a second and execute practiced motions, but retain little task state, and the memory of the VLAs largely disappears under scene randomization. Notably, on Mind2Act , the strongest system succeeds in only 12.0% of episodes, far below its 52.7% on Mind and 39.0% on Act , and no end-to-end policy exceeds 3.6%. Competence in either capability therefore does not carry over to Mind2Act tasks.
blocks.zh: 我们对Mind2Act World的评价显示了一个明显的模式. 现有架构在Mind and Act中并不平衡, 最强的剂保持了任务状态,但为保持接触而挣扎,其定时的成功用一个在推论中暂停的模拟器来测量. 端到端政策在一秒内响应并被执行实践动议,但保留了很少的任务状态,而VLA的记忆在场景随机化下基本消失. 值得注意的是,在Mind2 Act中,最强的系统仅成功12.0%,远远低于其在Mind上的52.7%和在Act上的39.0%,而且没有超过端到端政策。 3.6%. 因此,Mind2Act的两种能力都不属于任务范围。

blocks.en: The contributions of this work are summarized as follows: • We introduce Mind2Act World , a diagnostic benchmark comprising 30 manipulation tasks grounded in real-world requirements. Organized into three views, it systematically evaluates Mind , Act , and Mind-Action Composition . • We develop a diagnosis harness that combines rule-based analysis with an LLM judge to identify the stage at which each failed episode first breaks down and to attribute the failure to Mind , Act , or Mind-Action Composition . The harness also summarizes three representative models in model profile cards of their failure patterns and behavioral tendencies. • We evaluate representative multimodal agents, VLAs, and WAMs on shared tasks and scoring, with separate leaderboards for agents and end-to-end policies. Our results show that systems differ in which of Mind and Act is weaker, and that all of them struggle with Mind-Action Composition .

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Embodied Policies and Agents
blocks.zh: 2.1 健全的政策和代理人

blocks.en: Robot manipulation policies have evolved from imitation learning [ 15 , 16 , 17 ] to large-scale generalist policies. Vision-language-action models such as OpenVLA [ 19 ] , π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} [ 20 ] , RDT2 [ 21 ] and G0.5 [ 22 ] improve instruction following and cross-task transfer, while world-action models such as LDA-1B [ 24 ] , Motus [ 25 ] and DreamZero [ 26 ] couple predictive modeling with control. Agent-based systems take a different route, turning language-model reasoning into executable programs [ 32 ] and feeding success detection back into planning [ 67 , 68 ] . Recent work also addresses memory-augmented manipulation [ 29 , 30 , 55 ] , dynamic manipulation [ 61 , 62 ] , and force- or tactile-aware control [ 65 , 66 ] .
blocks.zh: 机器人操纵政策从模仿学习[15,16,17]演变为大规模通论政策. 愿景语-动作模型如OpenVLA [19], π 0.5\pi_{ 0.5} [20], RDT2 [21]和G0.5 [22] 改进了遵循和交叉任务转移的指令,而LDA-1B [24],Motus [25]和 DreamZero [26] 等世界动作模型则以控制为一对预测模型. 基于代理的系统采用不同的路线,将语言模型推理转化为可执行程序[32],并将成功检测反馈到规划[67,68]. 最近的工作还涉及记忆强化操纵[29.,30.,55],动态操纵[61.,62],以及力量或触觉控制[65.,66].

blocks.en: Despite this progress, each line is usually evaluated where only its own demand is hard: memory methods on tasks with simple execution, dynamic and contact-aware controllers on tasks whose target is given, and agents on tasks where perceiving the outcome is assumed. In practice, a failure may come from holding the wrong task state, missing the intended physical effect, or continuing without checking that the effect occurred. Mind2Act World therefore makes all three demands hard within the same tasks and evaluates agents, VLAs and WAMs on them.
blocks.zh: 尽管取得了这些进展,但每行通常都会在只有自身需求困难的地方进行评估:对任务采用简单执行的内存方法,对给出目标的任务采用动态和有接触意识的控制器,对设想结果的任务采用代理人. 在实践中,失败可能来自持有错误的任务状态,缺少预期的物理效果,或者在不检查效果的情况下继续发生. 思维2 因此, " 行动世界 " 在同一任务范围内使所有这三项要求都变得艰巨,并对代理人、志愿军和妇女军作出评价。

blocks.en: 2.2 Evaluation for Manipulation and Embodied Agents
blocks.zh: 2.2 对操纵和体能代理人的评价

blocks.en: Simulation benchmarks provide scalable testbeds for manipulation. RLBench [ 5 ] , CALVIN [ 33 ] and LIBERO [ 4 ] cover multi-task, language-conditioned and lifelong settings. RoboTwin 2.0 [ 34 ] evaluates bimanual generalization, and THE COLOSSEUM [ 48 ] stresses distribution shift. BEHAVIOR-1K [ 7 ] and RoboCasa [ 6 ] pose long household activities. Memory benchmarks such as RMBench [ 31 ] and RoboMME [ 38 ] isolate history-dependent decisions, the latter with Easy, Medium and Hard levels and timed stopping of moving objects. GeoMind [ 36 ] evaluates spatial reasoning and spatial memory through structured manipulation tasks, with controlled scene variations and diagnostic metrics for spatial understanding and execution failures. RoboDojo [ 8 ] and RobotWorld [ 9 ] diagnose capability dimensions with stage scores or execution traces, and real-world benchmarks such as RoboArena [ 41 ] assess deployed policies. For agents built on foundation models, EmbodiedBench [ 52 ] spans high-level and low-level embodied tasks, and Embodied Playground [ 11 ] evaluates closed-loop behavior in which earlier actions set up later prerequisites. X2Real [ 12 ] records subtask failure nodes, separates reasoning from manipulation dimensions including dynamic operation, and compares VLA, WAM and agent routes. RoboColiseum [ 13 ] reports a gap between task understanding and reliable execution. RLE-Bench [ 10 ] and Embodied First Exam [ 14 ] instead evaluate agents that write and iterate on code to solve robot control and robot learning engineering problems.
blocks.zh: 模拟基准为操纵提供了可伸缩的试验床。 RL Bench [5], CALVIN [33]和LIBERO [4] 涵盖多任务,语言条件和终身设置. RoboTwin 2.0 [34]评价双人通用,COLOSSEUM [48] 强调分配转移. BEHAVIOR-1K [7]和RoboCasa [6] 构成长期的家庭活动。 人民币[31]和RoboMME[38]等内存基准分离出以历史为依托的决定,后者具有易取,中取和难取等级别并定时停止移动对象. GeoMind [36] 通过结构化的操纵任务评价空间推理和空间内存,有可控的场景变化和用于空间理解和执行失败的诊断度量. RoboDojo [8]和RobobotWorld [9] 诊断能力维度有舞台分数或执行痕迹,而RoboArena等现实世界基准[41]评估所部署的政策. 对于基于基础模型的代理商来说,Embody Bench[52]跨出高层次和低层次所包含的任务,而Embody Playground[11]评价了封闭-loop行为,其中早期的行动设定了后期的先决条件. X2Real [12] 记录了子任务故障节点,将推理与包括动态操作在内的操纵维度区分开来,并比较了VLA,WAM和代理路由. RoboColiseum [13]报告任务理解与可靠执行之间存在差距. RLE-Bench [10] 和 Embody First Exam [14] 转而评价那些在代码上写作并脚踏实地的代理,以解决机器人控制和机器人学习工程问题.

blocks.en: Most of these benchmarks entangle reasoning and execution within one task, so a failure cannot be attributed to either, or measure them in separate evaluations, leaving open whether they hold together when one realized outcome sets the conditions for the next decision. Mind2Act World addresses this gap by deriving tasks from real-world requirements and organizing them into Mind, Act and Mind2Act views with graded difficulty, so that the same demands are measured in isolation and in composition across architectures. Table 1 compares Mind2Act World with 21 representative simulation benchmarks. Mind2Act World tasks also have long horizons, with training demonstrations averaging 60.7 s overall and 99.6 s in the Mind2Act view. Demonstrations in RoboTwin 2.0, RoboDojo, MIKASA-Robo-VLA and RoboCasa365 average 13 to 40 s, and only BEHAVIOR-1K, whose tasks are full household activities, has longer ones.
blocks.zh: 这些基准大多将推理和执行纠缠在一个任务之内,因此失败不能归咎于其中之一,也不能归因于单独评价,因此,当一个实现的结果为下个决定创造了条件时,这些基准是否团结在一起,还不清楚。 思维2 Act World通过从现实世界的要求中得出任务,并以分级困难的方式将它们组织成Mind,Act和Mind2Act的观点来弥补这一差距,从而孤立地在各种建筑的构成中衡量同样的需要. 表1 与Mind2的比较 Act World拥有21个代表性模拟基准. 思维2 行动世界的任务也有很长的地平线,培训示威在总体上平均为60.7个,在Mind2Act的视野中平均为99.6个。 在RoboTwin 2.0、RoboDojo、MIKASA-Robo-VLA和RoboCasa365的示威中,平均13至40秒,只有BEHAVIOR-1K(他们的任务是全家活动)有更长的时间。

blocks.en: 3 Mind2Act World Benchmark
blocks.zh: 3 思维2 行动世界基准

blocks.en: Mind2Act World asks whether failures in manipulation tasks arise from incorrect reasoning, imprecise execution, or a poor composition of the two. The benchmark comprises 30 simulation tasks on a bimanual ARX X5 platform, organized into 3 views that place different demands on a system. Mind focuses on history-dependent reasoning, Act emphasizes constrained physical execution, and Mind2Act focuses on their composition. Each task has Easy, Medium, and Hard levels, and each level is evaluated in a Clean and a Random scene setting, yielding 180 configurations . Fig. 1 presents an overview of our 30 tasks. The following sections describe the design principles (Section 3.1 ), task views (Section 3.2 ), difficulty levels (Section 3.3 ), training data (Section 3.4 ), and evaluation setting (Section 3.5 ).
blocks.zh: Mind2Act World询问操纵任务的失败是源于推理不正确,执行不精确,还是两者组成差. 该基准包括一个双人ARX X5平台的30个模拟任务,分为3个观点,对一个系统提出了不同的要求. 思想专注于历史的依赖推理, 法案强调受限制的行刑,而Mind2法案则侧重于其组成. 每个任务都有简单、中和硬等级别,每个级别都在一个干净和随机的场景设定中进行评估,产生180个配置。 图1概述了我们的30项任务。 以下各节介绍设计原则(第3.1节)、任务意见(第3.2节)、难度(第3.3节)、培训数据(第3.4节)和评价设置(第3.5节)。

Mind tasks emphasize decisions based on historical observation, Act tasks precise and timely physical execution, and Mind2Act tasks the closed-loop composition of the two, in which action outcomes guide subsequent decisions. Each view has ten tasks, and together they cover twelve capability categories and five application domains. The central wheel groups the capability categories by view; the surrounding tiles show each task’s ID and scene, framed by view. Each task has three difficulty levels and two scene settings ( Clean and Random ), giving 180 configurations.

blocks.en: 3.1 Design Principles
blocks.zh: 3.1 设计原则

blocks.en: Four principles guide the benchmark design: (i) build tasks from real-world requirements, (ii) evaluate reasoning and execution capabilities separately and in combination, (iii) verify physical outcomes and record task progress, and (iv) support evaluation across different model architectures.
blocks.zh: 四原则指导基准设计: (一)从现实世界要求中构建任务, (二)分别并综合评价推理和执行能力, (三)核实物理结果并记录任务进度, (四)支持跨不同模式架构的评价.

blocks.en: Embodied agents in industry, homes, and service settings must follow instructions across multiple stages and produce the required physical effects at the right time. We construct tasks in three steps. First, we identify a practical requirement, such as remembering orders after they leave view, maintaining a target instrument reading, intercepting objects on a conveyor, or responding to appliance feedback. We then reproduce this requirement in a tabletop scene and define completion conditions based on physical outcomes. Table 2 groups the tasks into five application domains: home and food service, manufacturing and logistics, instrument operation and dexterous tool use, assembly and physical reasoning, and companion and edutainment. It also identifies the industrial or service requirement behind each task. In the companion and edutainment domain, structured activities such as card matching and paddle ball represent cognitive and sports training for older adults and children. All thirty tasks are tabletop abstractions of such needs. They isolate the requirement that makes the activity hard for a robot and do not reproduce a deployed workflow in full.
blocks.zh: 工业、住宅和服务环境的健全代理人必须遵循多个阶段的指示,并在适当的时候产生所需的物理效果。 我们分三步构建任务。 首先,我们确定一个实际要求,比如在离开视线后记住命令,保持目标仪器读取,在传送器上拦截物体,或者响应实用反馈. 然后,我们在桌面场景中复制这一要求,并根据实际结果确定完成条件。 表2将任务分为五个应用领域:家用和食品服务、制造和物流、仪表操作和自相矛盾的工具使用、装配和物理推理以及同伴和娱乐。 它还确定了每项任务背后的工业或服务要求。 在同伴和娱乐领域,卡片配对和划桨球等结构化活动代表了老年和儿童的认知和体育训练. 所有30个任务都是这些需求的平面抽象。 它们隔离了使机器人的活动变得困难的要求,不完全复制部署的工作流程.

blocks.en: Long-horizon tasks often combine memory, planning, precision, and timing, making the source of failure difficult to identify. Mind2Act World evaluates these demands through three views with related task semantics. Mind tasks require only routine execution, so they examine how a system maintains and uses task state. Act tasks specify the required operation to examine its physical execution ability. Mind2Act tasks combine these demands and test composition in both directions. Retained task state guides actions, and the physical outcomes of those actions update that state. The views define observable task demands, not internal policy modules. Each view emphasizes one demand without removing the other. A Mind task still requires routine grasping and placing, and an Act task still requires reading the cue that it responds to. Strong performance on the separate demands with weak performance on their combination is therefore consistent with a composition problem. Because the views contain different tasks and Mind2Act workflows are also longer, view-level differences do not by themselves identify composition failures (Section 5.2 ). Matched interventions are left to future work (Section 7 ).
blocks.zh: 长视野任务往往结合记忆,规划,精确度,以及时间,使得失败的来源难以识别. 思维2 Act World通过三种观点与相关任务语义来评价这些需求. Mind任务只需要例行执行,所以它们检查一个系统如何维持和使用任务状态. 法案任务规定了检查其实际执行能力所需的操作. 思维2 行动任务将这些要求和测试组成结合起来,双向进行。 保留任务状态指导行动,这些行动的实际结果更新了这一状态。 意见界定了可观察到的任务要求,而不是内部政策单元。 每种观点都强调一种要求,而不去除另一种要求。 心灵任务仍需要例行的把握和布置, 因此,单项要求的强劲表现和组合的疲软表现符合组成问题。 由于这些观点包含不同的任务,而Mind2Act的工作流程也更长,因此视图层面的差异本身并不能单独识别组成故障(第5.2节. 相应的干预措施留给今后的工作处理(第7节)。

blocks.en: Task scores depend on simulator states and events. A deposit counts only after an object is released and supported at the target. A dial reading must remain stable after release, and a key strike must produce an effective press. The task records also distinguish incorrect decisions from failed execution, such as selecting the wrong object versus failing to place the correct one. Partial-progress scores and event records show which stages were completed and where the first observable error occurred.
blocks.zh: 任务分数取决于模拟状态和事件. 只有当对象被释放并在目标上得到支持后,存款才算数。 拨号读取出后必须保持稳定,按键出击后必须产生有效的新闻. 任务记录还区分了错误的决定和失败的执行,例如选择错误的对象与没有放置正确的对象. 部分进度分数和事件记录显示哪些阶段已经完成,哪些地方发生了第一个可观察到的错误。

blocks.en: The benchmark supports comparisons across architectures using shared tasks, instances, and scoring rules. End-to-end policies act from observations after training on the shared demonstrations; agents act through declared motion tools. Section 4 specifies what each interface exposes, so that differences in performance can be read against differences in information and control.
blocks.zh: 该基准支持采用共享任务、实例和评分规则对各种架构进行比较。 端到端政策是在对共同示威进行培训后从观察出发的;代理人通过宣布的运动工具采取行动。 第4节具体规定了每个接口所暴露的内容,以便对照信息和控制的不同来读取性能的差异.

blocks.en: 3.2 Task Design
blocks.zh: 3.2 任务设计

blocks.en: Task design follows the three views introduced above. Mind tests decisions that depend on earlier information (Section 3.2.1 ). Act tests whether a specified operation produces the required physical effect within spatial and temporal constraints (Section 3.2.2 ). Mind2Act tests their composition across dependent operations (Section 3.2.3 ). Within each view, tasks are grouped by capability. The following subsections explain each category through representative tasks and describe the failures it can reveal. Appendix Table 20 lists all tasks, their source workflows, categories, and difficulty variables. Appendix F provides the full specifications.
blocks.zh: 任务设计遵循上述三种观点。 依赖早期信息的思维测试决定(第3.2.1节)。 行为测试某一特定操作是否在空间和时间限度内产生所需的物理效果(第3.2.2.节)。 思维2 法案通过依赖性业务检验其构成(第3.2.3.节)。 在每种观点中,任务按能力分类。 以下各分节通过代表性任务来解释每个类别,并描述它能够揭示的失败. 附录表20列出了所有任务,其源工作流程,类别,和难度变量. 附 录 F提供了完整的规格。

blocks.en: 3.2.1 Mind: Reasoning over Long-Horizon Dependencies
blocks.zh: 3.2.1 注意: 长视距依赖的原因

blocks.en: A decision may depend on information that is no longer visible, such as a part on an earlier tray, the effect of an unlabeled control, or the portion of an order already served. These dependencies require a system to retain evidence and update task state throughout an episode. Many end-to-end visuomotor policies use only the current observation or a short history of recent frames [ 15 , 16 , 19 , 20 ] . Recent memory-augmented policies have begun to address this limitation [ 56 , 29 , 55 , 30 ] . Mind tasks examine whether a system can make correct decisions after relevant cues disappear, while requiring only routine execution.
blocks.zh: 裁决可能取决于不再可见的信息,如更早的托盘上的部分,未加标签的控制的效果,或已经送达的命令的部分. 这些依赖性需要一个系统来保留证据并在整个剧集中更新任务状态. 许多端到端的粘接器政策只使用当前观察或最近帧的短历史[15,16,19,20]. 最近的记忆强化政策已开始解决这一限制[56、29、55、30]。 Mind任务检查一个系统是否能够在相关提示消失后做出正确的决定,同时只需要例行执行.

blocks.en: The ten Mind tasks cover five memory categories, with two tasks per category. The categories differ in how earlier information supports later decisions. Entity memory retains an object’s identity or an associated value when its current appearance is insufficient. Feedback-rule learning uses interaction to infer and retain a rule or hidden configuration. Examples include learning the effects of unlabeled controls and recovering an arrangement from feedback that reports only the number of correct positions. Process memory tracks completed operations and their order, such as fulfilled requests or the original order of disassembled layers. Spatial memory retains locations when a reference frame moves or a map is hidden. Integrated memory combines identity, location, and order, as in tracking a covered workpiece or matching cards revealed two at a time. Difficulty increases the information to retain, such as bindings, layers, hazard cells, card pairs, or exchanges, while keeping precision demands low.
blocks.zh: 10 Mind任务包括5个内存类别,每个类别有两个任务. 这些类别在较早的信息如何支持以后的决定方面有所不同。 实体内存在当前外观不足时保留对象的身份或相关值. 反馈规则学习使用交互来推断并保留规则或隐藏配置. 这方面的例子包括学习无标签控制的效果,从只报告正确立场数目的反馈中恢复安排。 处理内存轨迹完成操作及其顺序,如满足请求或拆分层的原始顺序. 当一个参考框架移动或地图被隐藏时,空间内存会保留位置. 综合内存结合了身份,位置,和顺序,如在跟踪被覆盖的工件或匹配卡片时,一次透露出两张. 难度会增加要保留的信息,如捆绑,分层,危险细胞,卡对,或交换等,同时保持精度要求低.

blocks.en: We demonstrate representative cases in Fig. 2 . In workpiece tracking and route replay (M1), the robot remembers the target location and station route, tracks the hidden target through cover exchanges, and retrieves it to visit the required stations in order. This tests integrated memory of identity, location, and sequence. In steamer-stack order restoration (P2), the robot observes each basket’s contents as it unstacks the baskets, then restores their original order and replaces the lid. On Hard, distractor baskets have identical exteriors but different contents. The robot must retain the original layer order and select the correct baskets, testing process memory.
blocks.zh: 我们在图2中演示有代表性的案例。 在工作台跟踪和路线重放(M1)中,机器人记得目标位置和站点路线,通过封面交换跟踪隐藏目标,并按顺序将其取回访问所需的站点。 这测试了身份、位置和序列的综合记忆。 在蒸汽机-仓储订单恢复(P2)中,机器人在解开篮子时会观察每个篮子的内容,然后恢复原来的订单并取而代之地盖. 在"硬"上,分心者篮子具有相同的外形,但内容不同. 机器人必须保留原地层顺序并选择正确的篮子,测试过程内存.

blocks.en: Mind task records distinguish decision errors from execution errors, such as choosing the wrong item versus failing to place the correct one. Because execution is routine, an error on a Mind task usually comes from the task state a system maintains.
blocks.zh: Mind任务记录区分了决定错误和执行错误,例如选择错误的项目与没有放置正确的项目. 由于执行是例行公事,Mind任务的一个错误通常来自系统维护的任务状态.

blocks.en: 3.2.2 Act: Dynamic Response and Precise Physical Execution
blocks.zh: 3.2.2 法案:动态反应和精确的实物执行

blocks.en: Correct decisions must be translated into physical effects that meet spatial and temporal constraints. Common examples include intercepting conveyor objects, passing through cyclic gates, maintaining instrument readings, carrying loose loads, and folding fabric. Act tasks specify what to do and evaluate how it is executed. Act provides a reference for execution demands that also occur in Mind2Act workflows, such as conveyor pickup in meal assembly. This allows performance on separate operations to be compared with performance in a dependent workflow.
blocks.zh: 正确的决定必须转化为符合时空限制的物理效应。 常见的例子有截取传送器物体,通过环形门,保持仪表读取,携带松散的负载,和折叠织物等. 行动任务规定要做什么并评估如何执行。 法案为Mind2Act工作流程中也出现的执行要求提供了参考,如餐食装配中的传送接车. 这样可以将单独操作上的性能与所依赖的工作流程中的性能进行比较.

blocks.en: Dynamic response concerns the timing of an action’s effect relative to a changing scene. Examples include intercepting objects before they leave the reachable region, pressing a button within a cue window, and passing through a cyclic gate before it closes. Dynamic stability adds a related demand. The robot must control its own motion without disturbing a carried load, such as loose balls on a tray. Timing follows the simulation clock, which pauses during inference. Precise physical execution concerns spatial accuracy, contact, and stability. It includes setting instrument readings, maintaining tool contact along a path, controlling stamp orientation, folding cloth that remains flat after release, and spacing dominoes to complete a physical chain to a bell. Difficulty increases through shorter time windows, additional obstacles or loads, tighter tolerances, and less controllable materials or shapes.
blocks.zh: 动态反应涉及相对于变化的场景而言行动效果的时机. 例如,在物体离开可到达区域之前拦截物体,在提示窗口内按下一个按钮,并在关闭前通过一个循环门. 动态稳定性增加了相关的需求。 机器人必须控制自己的运动,而不扰动携带的负载,如托盘上松开的球. 时间跟随模拟时钟,在推论中暂停. 精确的物理执行涉及空间精度、接触和稳定性。 它包括设置仪器读取器,沿路保持工具接触,控制印花取向,将放出后保持平整的布被折叠,并间隔多米诺来完成一个物理链到铃. 通过缩短时间窗口,增加障碍或负载,收紧容受度,以及减少可控材料或形状,难度会增加.

blocks.en: Cases are demonstrated in Fig. 2 . In domino chain to a bell (PR6), the robot places dominoes upright along a curved band and pushes the first to trigger a chain that rings a bell. This requires precise spacing and orientation so that contact propagates through the chain. Difficulty increases with more dominoes, greater height variation, and a larger band span. In tray carrying with loose balls (DR4), the robot carries loose balls on a tray past obstacles while keeping each ball within its marked circle. This tests dynamic stability, as the robot must control tray motion to preserve the positions of the balls throughout transport.
blocks.zh: 在多米诺链到铃声(PR6)中,机器人沿着弯曲的带将多米诺(domino)直立地放置,并推出第一个触发铃声的链条。 这需要精确的间隔和取向,以便接触通过链条传播。 随着多米诺的出现,高度的变异增加,波段也增加,难度增加。 在托盘中携带松散的球(DR4),机器人将松散的球放入托盘上过道障碍,同时将每个球都保留在被标记的圆圈内. 这测试了动态稳定性,因为机器人必须控制托盘运动,在整个运输过程中保持球的位置.

blocks.en: Act tasks assess endpoint accuracy, stability after release, contact continuity, and timing. By limiting long-horizon reasoning demands, they provide a reference for interpreting execution failures in Mind2Act workflows.
blocks.zh: 行动任务评估端点准确性、释放后的稳定性、接触连续性和时间安排。 通过限制长视推理要求,它们为解释Mind2Act工作流程中的执行失败提供了参考.

blocks.en: 3.2.3 Mind2Act: Composition across Dependent Operations
blocks.zh: 3.2.3 Mind2法案:各种依赖性行动的组成

blocks.en: Mind2Act evaluates how reasoning and execution interact across a workflow. Retained information, such as an order, layout, or recipe sequence, determines the next operation and its execution requirements. Each physical outcome then changes the task state on which later decisions depend. A system may handle the separate demands yet struggle to combine them over time. Mind2Act therefore focuses on outcome-conditioned continuation , that is, choosing subsequent actions from the state produced by earlier operations. Each task combines a memory or reasoning demand with a physical execution demand, as listed in Appendix Table 20 .
blocks.zh: 思维2 行动评价推理和执行如何在工作流程中相互作用。 保留的信息,如命令,布局,或食谱序列,决定了下一步操作及其执行要求. 然后,每个物理结果都会改变以后决定所依赖的任务状态。 一个系统可能处理不同的要求,但随着时间的推移却难以将它们结合起来。 思维2 因此,法案侧重于以结果为条件的延续,即从先前行动所产生的国家中选择后续行动。 每项任务将内存或推理需求与实际执行需求相结合,如附录表20所列出.

blocks.en: The tasks cover five composition mechanisms. In cumulative progress (CP01, CP03), remaining demand or slot occupancy determines the next operation. Progress advances only after successful delivery or stable plate placement. In state-dependent prerequisites and repair (CP02, CP08, CP09), later operations require a valid physical state. The robot may need to stop a turntable before covering a cake, rebuild a misplaced base to match a remembered blueprint, or redraw original strokes removed during erasing. In feedback-driven adjustment (CP04, CP06), temperature or balance-beam deflection guides the next operation. In sequence and plan execution (CP05, CP07), a remembered sequence or a construction plan determines the order of operations. Progress requires effective strikes or stable placements; CP07 also requires a toy car to cross the completed bridge. In predictive decision under time pressure (CP10), the robot applies a fixed color rule to each incoming ball: return a white ball and let a red ball pass. It must select and time its response before the ball arrives.
blocks.zh: 任务包括五个组成机制。 在累积进展(CP01,CP03)中,剩余的需求或档位占用决定了下一次运营. 只有在成功交付或稳定地放置板块后才能取得进展。 在国家依赖的先决条件和修理(CP02,CP08,CP09)中,后期操作需要有效的物理状态. 机器人可能需要在覆盖蛋糕之前先停止一个转盘,重建一个错误的基座来匹配被铭记的蓝图,或者在去除时重新绘制去掉的原始中风. 在反馈驱动的调整(CP04,CP06)中,温度或平衡波束偏移指导下一项操作. 在顺序和计划执行(CP05,CP07)中,被记住的顺序或建设计划决定了运行的顺序. 进步需要有效的罢工或稳定的安置;CP07还需要一辆玩具车来穿过已完工的桥. 在时间压力下的预测性决定(CP10)中,机器人对每个入球都适用了固定的颜色规则:返回一发白球并让一发红球通过. 它必须在球到来之前选择和时间反应.

blocks.en: In rotating-cake decoration (CP02), the robot remembers a briefly shown macaron layout and reproduces it on a rotating cake. It must stop the turntable and verify that the cake is stationary before placing the cover. In temperature-controlled cooking (CP04), the robot adds ingredients in the remembered recipe order, then uses temperature feedback to switch from HEAT to KEEP WARM within the required time window. Bridge building for a toy car (CP07) requires selecting suitable parts and executing a construction plan. The assembled bridge must remain stable after release and support the car as it crosses the gap, linking plan execution to a physical test of the completed structure. In whiteboard restoration (CP09), the robot compares the current board with a remembered drawing to identify added strokes. It must erase these strokes and redraw any original content removed during erasing, so that the final board matches the remembered colors, shapes, and layout.
blocks.zh: 在旋转-蛋糕装饰(CP02)中,机器人记得一个短暂的显示出马卡龙布局,并在旋转蛋糕上再现. 它必须停止转盘,在放置封面之前核实蛋糕是固定的. 在温度控制烹饪(CP04)中,机器人在被记住的食谱顺序中添加了成分,然后使用温度反馈在所需要时间窗口内从HEAT切换到KEEP WARM. 玩具车的桥梁建筑(CP07)需要选择合适的部件并执行一项建造计划. 组装的桥在放行后必须保持稳定,并支撑行车跨越缺口,将计划执行与完成的结构的物理测试联系起来. 在"白板"修复(CP09)中,机器人将目前的"活板"与被记住的画作相提并论,以识别所添加的中风. 它必须去掉这些划线并重新绘制任何在去除过程中去掉的原始内容,使最终的棋盘与被铭记的颜色,形状和布局相匹配.

blocks.en: Mind2Act examines whether a system uses retained information to guide execution and updates that information from physical outcomes. Comparisons across views, supported by stage and event records, help identify composition failures.
blocks.zh: 思维2 法案审查一个系统是否使用保留的信息来指导执行并更新来自实际结果的信息. 不同观点的比较,有阶段记录和事件记录的支持,有助于识别构成失败.

blocks.en: Task difficulty often arises during intermediate operations. Fig. 2 shows four steps from each of eight Hard-level demonstrations, two Mind, two Act and four Mind2Act tasks. At Hard, M1 involves seven cover exchanges, two of them irrelevant, and P2 involves four steamer tiers and two identical decoys. PR6 involves nine dominoes of mixed sizes along a 76 cm curved band, and DR4 involves four loose balls, two pillars and a marked circle of 20 mm radius. CP02 shows its sample for 3 s, CP04 involves bimanual jar handling and a switch from HEAT to KEEP WARM within 2 s of the pot reaching 80 °C, CP07 uses 13 of 28 parts across a 36 cm river, and CP09 requires uncapping pens with both hands. Failures in these intermediate operations can prevent later stages from succeeding, so we report stage progress alongside final success (Section 4.3 ).
blocks.zh: 任务困难往往发生在中间作业期间. 图2显示8个硬层示威中每站有4个步骤,其中2个是Mind,2个是Act和4个Mind2Act任务. 在Hard,M1涉及7个封面交换,其中2个无关紧要,而P2则涉及4个蒸汽机级和2个相同的诱饵. PR6涉及由76厘米曲线带相接而成的9个多米诺,而DR4则涉及4个松散球,2个柱子和20毫米半径的标志圆. CP02显示其样本为3 s,CP04涉及双人罐处理,从HEAT到KEEP的WARM在锅内2 s到80 °C的切换,CP07使用横跨一出36 cm河的28个部分中的13个,CP09需要用双手取出活笔. 这些中间行动的失败会阻碍以后阶段的成功,因此,我们报告阶段的进展和最后的成功(第4.3节)。

blocks.en: Figure 2 : Difficult steps inside eight Hard-level tasks. Each panel follows one Hard-level demonstration through four intermediate steps and shows what makes each step hard: the bold label under a frame names the operation, and the italic line the demand that makes it difficult. A failure at any of these steps blocks the stages after it. The color of the task ID gives its view, and the tag beside the task name the Hard-level setting; Fig. 3 compares the levels themselves.
blocks.zh: 图2:8个硬级任务中的困难步骤。 每个面板通过四个中间步骤遵循一个硬层演示,并显示使每个步骤硬化的原因:一个框下粗体的标签来命名操作,而斜线则显示使操作困难的需求. 任何这些步骤的失败都会阻碍之后的阶段. 任务 ID 的颜色给出了它的视图, 任务名称旁的标签为 Hard- Level 设置; 图 3 比较级别本身 。

blocks.en: 3.3 Difficulty Design
blocks.zh: 3.3 难以设计

blocks.en: Aggregate scores can obscure the conditions under which performance declines. We therefore define three difficulty levels for each task. The objective remains fixed, while memory load, reasoning demands, precision, timing, or workflow dependencies increase. Easy tests the core requirement under the least demanding conditions. Medium increases the information to retain, the required precision, or the number of operations. Hard introduces greater demands through tighter constraints, longer dependent sequences, or combinations of these factors. The levels define a progression within each task rather than a common numerical scale across tasks. Comparing success and partial-progress scores across the three levels shows how performance on the same task changes as its demands increase. Fig. 3 illustrates these variations. Mind tasks increase the information to retain, such as unknown mappings, blocks, hidden hazards, or card pairs, while requiring only routine execution. Act tasks vary physical demands, including load, path shape, fold geometry, and domino count. Mind2Act tasks vary orders, river width, shapes, or balls to increase the number and dependencies of operations. Appendix F specifies every task and difficulty level.
blocks.zh: 合计分数可能掩盖业绩下降的条件。 因此,我们为每项任务确定了三个困难层次。 目标保持不变,同时内存负荷,推理要求,精度,时间,或工作流程依赖性增加. 在最不苛刻的条件下,容易测试核心要求. 中度会增加保留的信息,所需的精度,或操作的次数. 硬性通过更严格的制约,较长的依赖序列,或这些因素的组合,引入了更大的需求. 这些级别界定的是每项任务的进展,而不是跨任务的共同数字尺度。 比较三个级别上的成功和部分进展的分数显示,执行相同任务的业绩如何随着需求增加而变化。 图3说明了这些差异。 Mind任务会增加要保留的信息,例如未知的映射,块,隐藏的隐患,或卡对,同时只需要例行执行. 行为任务不同物理要求,包括负载,路径形状,折叠几何,多米诺计数. 思维2 行为任务不同命令,河宽,形状,或球来增加操作的数量和依赖性. 附 录 F 指定了每个任务和难度级别。

blocks.en: Figure 3 : Easy, Medium and Hard levels of twelve tasks. Four tasks per view at Easy , Medium and Hard . A harder level keeps the goal and raises one or more task demands: Mind tasks add more to remember or infer, Act tasks require more spatial accuracy and physical stability, and Mind2Act tasks lengthen the workflow or shorten the response window. The label under each frame gives the parameter that changes, and the icon beside each task name gives the kind of demand (key below the panels; its counts cover all 30 tasks).
blocks.zh: 图3:12项任务的简单、中和难度。 在 Easy、Media 和 Hard 上, 更硬的关卡能守住目标,并提出一项或多项任务要求: Mind任务会增加更多的记忆或推断,Act任务需要更多的空间精度和物理稳定性,Mind2Act任务会延长工作流程或缩短响应窗口. 每个框架下的标签给出了变化的参数,每个任务名称旁的图标给出了需求的类型(面板下方的键;其计数涵盖了所有30个任务).

blocks.en: 3.4 Training Data and Collection
blocks.zh: 3.4 培训数据和收集

blocks.en: To compare end-to-end policies fairly, we provide expert demonstrations collected under one protocol for every task and level. Section 3.4.1 describes how they are generated and checked, and Section 3.4.2 summarizes the resulting data.
blocks.zh: 为了公平比较端到端政策,我们为每一项任务和级别提供根据一个协议收集的专家演示。 第3.4.1节说明了如何产生和检查这些数据,第3.4.2节概述了由此产生的数据。

blocks.en: 3.4.1 Data Collection and Quality Control
blocks.zh: 3.4.1 数据收集和质量控制

blocks.en: Each episode has a setup defined at three levels. The task determines the objective and rules, the difficulty level determines the demands, and episode parameters specify variations such as object positions, orders, or target readings. Task scripts define the operation sequence and end-effector targets. Inverse kinematics and motion planning convert these targets into joint trajectories. Quality control checks physical completion against simulator states and events. For example, CP01 requires the requested items to be released into the correct tray and remain supported. Recording checks cover missing or corrupted frames, invalid state or action values, timestamp alignment, and duplicates. Demonstrations must also satisfy task-specific qualification conditions to provide clear examples for learning. A DR3 demonstration must retain at least one second of withdrawal margin, and an M2 demonstration must use only information revealed by actual card flips. These conditions are stricter than task success requirements and apply to demonstration selection rather than policy scoring. Every retained demonstration passes the evaluator used at test time. The collection therefore also shows that each task and level can be completed on this platform by a scripted controller with access to simulator state. Demonstration and evaluation seeds are disjoint.
blocks.zh: 每集有一个设定,定义为三个级别. 任务决定了目标和规则,难度级别决定了需求,而插曲参数则指定了诸如对象位置,命令,或目标读取等变化. 任务脚本定义了操作序列和最终效果目标. 反向动能和运动规划将这些目标转换为联合出轨. 质量控制对照模拟状态和事件检查实体完成情况. 例如,CP01要求将所请求的项目放入正确的托盘并保持支持. 记录检查覆盖缺失或被损坏的帧,无效状态或动作值,时间戳校正,以及重复. 示范还必须符合特定任务的资格条件,为学习提供明确的例子。 DR3演示必须至少保留一秒取出比值,而M2演示必须只使用由实际卡翻所显示的信息. 这些条件比任务成功要求更严格,适用于示范选择而不是政策评分. 每次保留演示都通过测试时使用的评审员. 因此,集合还显示,每个任务和关卡都可以由可访问模拟状态的被脚本控制器在这个平台上完成. 示范和评价种子是脱节的。

blocks.en: 3.4.2 Data Statistics
blocks.zh: 3.4.2 国家 数据统计

blocks.en: Each episode records the task instruction, RGB images from a head camera and two wrist cameras at 640 × 480 640\times 480 , and joint states and targets. Physics runs at 120 Hz, and the recorded data are sampled at 30 Hz. Across the thirty tasks, the dataset contains 50 episodes per task and difficulty level , resulting in 4,500 episodes , 8.19 million frames per camera , and 75.8 hours of recordings, as detailed in Appendix Table 8 . Mind and Mind2Act episodes average 58.5 and 99.6 seconds, compared with 23.9 seconds for Act. These averages are approximately 2.5 and 4.2 times the Act average, respectively. Hard Mind2Act episodes average 127.6 seconds.
blocks.zh: 每集记录任务指示,从一个头相机和两个手腕相机中以640×480640\times 480记录RGB图像,以及联合状态和目标. 物理运行为120赫兹,所记录的数据被取样为30赫兹. 如附录表8所详述,在30个任务中,数据集包含每个任务和难度的50个集,导致4 500个集,每个相机819万帧,以及75.8小时的录音。 Mind和Mind2Act平均出场58.5秒和99.6秒,而Act则为23.9秒. 这些平均数分别约为该法平均数的2.5和4.2倍。 困难思维2 演戏平均127.6秒.

blocks.en: 3.5 Evaluation Setting
blocks.zh: 3.5 评价

blocks.en: Figure 4 : Examples of the Clean and Random settings. Every task is evaluated in both settings; shown are the first head-camera frames of three example tasks. Clean scenes use default materials and lighting without clutter, and each Random slot adds clutter and varies surfaces and lighting (dots: table color, light tint) while keeping the task’s objects, targets and events.
blocks.zh: 图4:清洁和随机设置的实例。 每个任务在两种设置中都得到评价;显示为三个实例任务的首个头相机框架. 干净的场景使用默认的材料和没有杂乱无章的照明,每个随机槽都会增加杂乱无章地和不同的表面和照明(dots:表色,淡锡),同时保留任务的对象,目标和事件.

blocks.en: Policies are evaluated through closed-loop interaction with the environment. Each episode starts from a predefined test instance, and the system selects actions using updated observations. Execution ends on task completion, task-defined failure, system termination, or budget exhaustion. Each configuration is defined by a task, a difficulty level, and a scene setting. An end-to-end policy runs all 50 instances of each configuration, and an agent runs a shared subset of 5. Instance parameters are fixed in advance and shared across systems within the same evaluation protocol to control variation between runs.
blocks.zh: 政策是通过与环境的封闭式互动加以评价的。 每集从一个预先定义的测试实例开始,系统使用更新的观测结果选择动作. 执行结束于任务完成、任务确定失败、系统终止或预算耗尽。 每个配置由任务,难度级别和场景设置来定义. 一个端到端政策运行每个配置的所有50个实例,一个代理运行一个共享子集为5个. 实例参数预先固定,并在同一评价协议内在系统之间共享,以控制运行间的差异.

blocks.en: We report two metrics. Final success rate is the fraction of valid episodes that meet all completion conditions. Task score ranges from 0 to 100 and measures partial progress under task-specific rules. High task scores with low final success indicate that a system completes parts of a task but often fails to meet all requirements. This distinction supports analysis of incomplete workflows in Mind2Act. Both metrics are computed from simulator states and events. Invalid or missing runs are recorded separately. Section 4 specifies the interfaces, timing, scoring, and aggregation rules.
blocks.zh: 我们报告两个标准。 最终成功率是符合所有完成条件的有效事件分数. 任务得分从0分到100分不等,并根据任务特定规则衡量部分进展. 任务分数高,最终成功率低,表明一个系统完成了任务的部分内容,但往往不能满足所有要求. 这种区分支持对Mind2Act中不完整的工作流程的分析. 这两个指标都是从模拟状态和事件计算出来的。 无效或缺失的运行会被单独记录 。 第4节规定了接口、时间、评分和汇总规则。

blocks.en: 3.5.1 Episode Variation and Randomization
blocks.zh: 3.5.1 变相和随机化

blocks.en: Episodes share the same objective, rules, and difficulty level but vary task-specific initial states and parameters. These include object layouts, initial and target states such as end-effector poses, and event sequences such as piano-key order. Some tasks also vary continuous and hidden parameters. In CP10, launcher position and aim are sampled continuously, while the task seed determines the order of red and white balls. In PR5, the target angle is sampled from a set defined for each difficulty level. The sheet displays a target arrow without revealing the numerical angle or tolerance. These variations test whether a system can adapt its behavior rather than replay a memorized trajectory. Using shared test instances supports controlled comparisons. Each task and difficulty level is evaluated in two scene settings, which we treat as separate configurations, giving 180 configurations in total (30 tasks × \times 3 levels × \times 2 settings). The Clean setting fixes scene appearance. The Random setting uses the same task instances and additionally varies clutter, table and floor materials, and lighting as depicted in Fig. 4 . Because the two settings share task instances, comparing them isolates the effect of visual and scene perturbation from that of task demands. Appendix A.4 details how the two settings are generated.
blocks.zh: Episoides有相同的目标,规则,和难度级别,但不同任务特定的初始状态和参数. 这些包括对象布局,初始状态和目标状态,如端效器姿势等,以及钢琴键顺序等事件序列等. 一些任务也不同了连续和隐藏的参数. 在CP10中,发射器位置和瞄准被连续地取样,而任务种子则决定了红白球的顺序. 在PR5中,目标角度取自为每个难度级别定义的一组. 工作表显示一个目标箭头,而不显示数字角度或容忍度。 这些变化测试一个系统是否能够调整其行为,而不是重放被记住的轨迹. 使用共享测试实例支持有控制的比较. 每个任务和难度级别在两个场景设置中进行评估,我们将其作为单独的配置来对待,总共给出了180个配置(30个任务x\time 3个级别x\time 2个设置). 干净的设置会修正场景的外观. " 随机 " 设置使用同样的任务实例,另外,还使用Fig中描述的杂乱无章、桌子和地板材料以及照明。 4 (韩语). 由于两个设置共享任务实例,比较它们将视觉和场景扰动的效果与任务需要的效果隔离开来. 附录A.4详细介绍了两种设置是如何生成的.

blocks.en: 4 Technical Implementation and Evaluation Protocol
blocks.zh: 4 技术实施和评价议定书

blocks.en: Systems that act through different interfaces must face the same scenes, the same clock and the same notion of success. Building on the task design in Section 3 , this section describes how policies connect to the tasks, how an episode is executed and timed, and how its outcome is scored and protected against shortcuts. Appendix B collects the implementation details needed for reproduction.
blocks.zh: 通过不同界面行事的系统必须面对相同的场景,相同的时钟和相同的成功概念. 本节以第3节中的任务设计为基础,描述了政策如何与任务相联,一个插曲是如何执行和定时的,以及其结果如何被打入分数并防范捷径. 附 录 B收集复制所需的实施细节.

blocks.en: Figure 5 : Training, evaluation and diagnosis pipeline. Training : end-to-end policies are fine-tuned on 4,500 demonstrations generated by scripted experts. Evaluation : the policies predict action chunks and the agents call motion tools, while the evaluator decides success from simulator state hidden from both. Diagnosis : episode logs feed a model profile card, which records where each failed episode first breaks down and whether the failure lies in Mind , Act or their composition (Section 6.1 ). Dashed elements are the next stage of the loop. The failure codes on a card become concrete changes (Table 7 ), and the improved model is evaluated again (Section 7 ). The evaluation and diagnosis panels trace one recorded GPT-6 Astra episode on S1 Medium, and the card panel is illustrative.
blocks.zh: 图5:培训、评价和诊断管道。 培训:对由编剧专家产生的4,500个示范项目进行了细化。 评价:政策预测动作块和代理人调用运动工具,而评价者从隐藏在两者的模拟状态中决定成功。 诊断:插曲日志输入了一张模型剖面卡,该卡记录了每个失败的插曲首先分出的地方,以及失败是否由Mind, Act或组成(第6.1节. 被掩盖的元素是循环的下个阶段. 卡片上的故障代码成为了具体的改变(表7),改进后的模式再次得到评价(第7节)。 评价和诊断面板追踪了S1中录制的一集GPT-6 Astra相片,卡片面板具有说明性.

blocks.en: 4.1 Platform and Policy Interfaces
blocks.zh: 4.1 平台和政策接口

blocks.en: Comparing agents and end-to-end policies requires a platform that both can drive and that produces the same physical effects for both. We implement Mind2Act World in Isaac Sim with two ARX X5 arms and parallel grippers. A fixed head camera captures the scene layout, while two wrist cameras capture local gripper-object interactions. RGB images are rendered at 640 × 480 640\times 480 for all cameras. Task scenes combine shared robot and workspace assets with task-specific objects and mechanisms as depicted in Fig. 6 . Their geometry, motion, and contact properties are configured to reproduce the physical effects required by each task.
blocks.zh: 比较代理人和端到端政策需要一个既能驱动又能对两者产生相同物理效果的平台。 我们在Isaac Sim执行Mind2Act World,配有两把ARX X5臂和相平行的握手. 固定头相机能捕捉到场景布局,而两个腕相机能捕捉到局部的抓取-物体相互作用. RGB影像以640×480 640\times 480为所有相机提供. 任务场景将共享的机器人和工作空间资产与图6所描绘的特定任务对象和机制相结合. 它们的几何,运动和接触属性被配置成复制每个任务所需的物理效果.

blocks.en: Figure 6 : Task setups grouped by application domain. Nineteen of the thirty tasks are shown with the objects and equipment each one uses. All thirty tasks are performed by the same two-arm ARX X5 robot.
blocks.zh: 图6:按应用程序域分组的任务设置. 在30项任务中,有19项以每个任务所用的物体和设备显示。 所有30个任务都由同一个双臂ARX X5机器人来完成.

blocks.en: All systems follow a common information contract detailed in Appendix B . Policies receive the task instruction, selected RGB views, and declared robot state. History access is limited to information previously exposed within the same episode. Hidden simulator state is accessible only to the evaluator. This includes unannounced parameters used for scoring, such as the numerical target angle and tolerance in PR5, gate timing in DR3, and allowable ball drift in DR4.
blocks.zh: 所有系统都遵循附录B所详述的共同信息合同。 政策接收任务指令,选择RGB视图,并宣布机器人状态. 历史访问仅限于此前在同一集中被曝光的信息. 隐藏模拟器状态仅可供评估者访问 。 这包括用于打分的未事先通知的参数,如PR5中的数字目标角和耐受性,DR3中门计时和DR4中允许的球漂移等.

blocks.en: The benchmark supports two action interfaces. End-to-end policies predict joint or end-effector actions. These predictions are converted to joint targets, and a configured number of actions is executed from each chunk before the next prediction. Agents are multimodal language models that issue structured tool calls. The move_eef tool accepts an end-effector pose target and gripper command. The backend handles inverse kinematics and motion planning. The wait_steps tool advances simulation while maintaining the current arm and gripper targets. Agents can use memory_resolve to retrieve a previously observed image by its observation identifier and add it to the model’s context. Retrieval does not advance simulation. An agent can also call give_up to end the episode itself. Every evaluated agent uses this one fixed harness of tools, planner and history access. The same two interfaces cover every task interaction, including count-only feedback (F2), an unnumbered needle gauge (CP06), unnumbered buttons (M2), keypad input (E2), bimanual uncapping (CP09), and tray carrying with loose balls (DR4). No task requires a task-specific interface.

blocks.en: 4.2 Episode Protocol and Timing
blocks.zh: 4.2 总议定书和时间安排

blocks.en: Each episode starts from a fixed instance for its task, difficulty level and scene setting, and systems evaluated under the same protocol use the same instance list. Reset restores the robot, objects, task stage, evaluator, and random-number state. Policy memory is cleared between episodes and retained across stages within an episode. Physics simulation advances at 120 Hz , while arm and gripper targets are updated at 30 Hz . Simulation pauses during model inference. Task deadlines use simulation time , while inference latency and total runtime use wall-clock time , the elapsed real time. A delayed model response therefore consumes wall-clock time without reducing the simulated response window, so timed tasks measure responses in simulation time rather than real-time performance. For end-to-end policies, each task and difficulty level has an episode horizon set to 1.2 times the 90th percentile of demonstration durations, rounded up to a control step. These simulation-time limits range from 16.27–420.50 s for Mind, 6.27–156.47 s for Act, and 34.40–308.50 s for Mind2Act. Agents receive four times this physics budget and at most 150 decisions per episode, since a tool call spans many control steps. Wall-clock limits are safety stops, not task limits. An episode stopped by one is scored like any other unfinished episode. Episodes end on completion, policy termination, or budget exhaustion. Simulator crashes and incomplete records are not counted as task failures, and infrastructure aborts are rerun. Appendices A and B specify episode horizons, model-call budgets, and scheduling.

blocks.en: A success rate alone says how often a task is finished but not how far a failed episode got, while a progress score alone can reward work that never completes the task. We therefore report the final success rate (SR), where success requires the complete task predicate, together with a 0–100 task score that credits task-specific progress and equals 100 exactly when the episode succeeds. Partial credit never overrides an unmet terminal requirement. For a task, level and system with N N eligible attempts and outcomes s i ∈ { 0 , 1 } s_{i}\in\{0,1\} , the success rate is S ^ = 1 N ​ ∑ i = 1 N s i , \hat{S}=\frac{1}{N}\sum_{i=1}^{N}s_{i}, (1) with protocol timeouts counted as failures and infrastructure aborts rerun. View summaries average the ten tasks of a view, each pooled over its three levels, and the primary result averages the Clean and Random settings. A robot is useful when it completes whole workflows, and in such workflows remembered information and physical execution depend on each other, so strength in either capability alone is not enough. For this reason, the Overall score weights the views as 0.25 0.25\, Mind + 0.25 \,+\,0.25\, Act + 0.50 \,+\,0.50\, Mind2Act, so that Mind2Act counts as much as the two single views together. As a descriptive reference for composition, we also compare a system’s Mind2Act success rate with the product of its Mind and Act success rates, the value expected if a Mind2Act workflow required one independent success of each kind. blocks.en: 4.4 Evaluation Integrity
blocks.zh: 4.4 评价

blocks.en: Because an agent can declare that it has finished and a policy can repeat an action until something happens, the evaluator has to judge outcomes. Completion is therefore assessed using environment-side predicates . Commands and success declarations receive credit only when the required physical conditions are met. Repeating an action earns credit only when it satisfies a new requirement. Task rules distinguish irreversible failures, unscored actions, and valid exploration. For example, in DR4, a ball leaving its circle causes failure even if it later rolls back. In F2, submitting an incomplete layout does not consume an attempt. In M2, revealing a mismatched pair is valid exploration. Any action sequence that satisfies the task rules is valid. A run is classified as a valid failure only when its record is sufficient to evaluate the final success conditions. Unavailable observations and infrastructure interruptions are recorded separately.
blocks.zh: 由于一个代理人可以宣布它已经完成,而一个政策可以重复一个动作直到发生某种事,评价者必须判断结果. 因此,利用环境侧上游评估完成情况。 命令和成功申报只有在符合必要的实际条件时才能获得信贷。 重复一项行动只有在满足了新的要求时才能获得信贷。 任务规则区分了不可逆转的失败,无分数的行动,以及有效的探索. 例如,在DR4中,一球离开它的圆会造成失败,即使它后来滚回. 在F2中,提交不完整的布局并不消耗尝试. 在M2中,揭示出一对不匹配是有效的探索. 符合任务规则的任何动作序列都是有效的. 跑步只有在其记录足以评估最终成功条件时才被归类为有效的失败. 无法获得的观察和基础设施中断情况另行记录。

blocks.en: 5 Benchmark Results
blocks.zh: 5 基准结果

blocks.en: Building on the protocol in Section 4 , we evaluate nine systems that span the two main routes to embodied manipulation: multimodal agents that act through tools and end-to-end policies trained on demonstrations. Section 5.1 describes the systems and the evaluation procedure. Section 5.2 analyzes how well they reason, act and compose the two, where and why they fall short across views, conditions and application domains, and what the evaluation costs in time and money. Section 5.3 summarizes which system suits which task.
blocks.zh: 在第四节协议的基础上,我们评价9个系统,这些系统跨越了体现操纵的两个主要路线:通过工具行事的多式联运代理人和经过示范培训的端到端政策。 第5.1节介绍了这些制度和评价程序。 第5.2节分析了它们如何解释、采取行动和构成两者,它们在哪里和为什么在观点、条件和应用领域之间不尽人意,以及评价花费的时间和金钱。 第5.3节概述了哪些系统适合哪些任务。

blocks.en: OVERALL How well do current systems reason, act and compose the two?
blocks.zh: 总计 目前的系统如何解释、发挥和构成两者?

blocks.en: Current systems can perform single skills but rarely combine them. Table 4 ranks agents and end-to-end policies on separate leaderboards because the two families are evaluated under different settings (Section 5.1 ). On both leaderboards, the leading systems succeed in only a minority of episodes, with 34.6% for GPT-6 Astra among the agents and 8.7% for InternW0 among the end-to-end policies. The remaining seven systems stay between 2.9% and 7.0%, far below either leader. These low rates are not explained by the tasks themselves, because under the same evaluator a scripted controller with access to simulator state completes every task at every level (Section 3.4.1 ). Nor is the agent harness the only limit, since the three agents share one harness and GPT-6 Astra still succeeds more than five times as often as the next agent. The shortfall therefore most likely lies in the models themselves.
blocks.zh: 目前的系统可以发挥单一技能,但很少结合这些技能。 表4将代理商和端对端政策排在不同的领导板上,因为两个家庭在不同的环境下进行评估(第5.1节)。 在两个领导板上,领先系统只在少数几起事件中取得成功,其中GPT-6 Astra的代理商占34.6%,InternW0的代理商占8.7%。 其余7个系统保持在2.9%至7.0%之间,远远低于两个领导者。 这些低率不是由任务本身来解释的,因为在同一评估人员下,一个可访问模拟状态的脚本控制器在每个级别完成每一项任务(第3.4.1节)。 毒剂也并非唯一的极限,因为三个毒剂共用一个毒剂,而GPT-6 Astra仍然比下一个毒剂成功的次数多出五倍多. 因此,最有可能的是模式本身。

blocks.en: This progress is also narrow, as Mind and Act tasks, each of which tests a single capability, supply between 81% and 100% of the successes of every system. Within these tasks, the successes cluster on a few practiced motions. Gate passage (DR3) is the clearest case, as this single timed task supplies between 36% and 41% of all successes of KinRT, π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} and X-VLA and about 70% of those of FastWAM. At the other extreme, eight of the thirty tasks (M1, DR4, PR5, PR6, CP03, CP04, CP07 and CP09) are completed by no system in any of the 56,700 episodes.
blocks.zh: 这一进展也是有限的,因为Mind and Act的任务,每个任务都测试一个单一的能力,每个系统的成功率在81%到100%之间。 在这些任务中,成功之处集中在一些实际动议上。 门道(DR3)是最明显的例子,因为这个单定时任务提供KinRT、 0.5\pi\0.5}和X-VLA的所有成功率的36%至41%,以及FastWAM的成功率的70%。 在另一个极端,30个任务中的8个任务(M1,DR4,PR5,PR6,CP03,CP04,CP07和CP09)在56,700集的任何一集中都没有系统完成.

blocks.en: The overall ranking hides this, because a system can lead it on single skills alone. For example, InternW0 leads the end-to-end leaderboard because of its Mind and Act results, yet its Mind2Act success rate (3.0%) is below that of π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} (3.6%). The per-view results show that the two families fail in different ways, as the strongest agent retains task state but struggles to sustain contact, whereas the end-to-end policies execute practiced motions but retain little task state. Both families break down once the two capabilities must work together in one workflow. The VLAs also lose much of their memory when the scene looks different, and Mind2Act workflows collapse most steeply as the difficulty rises.
blocks.zh: 总体排名掩盖了这一点,因为一个系统可以单独带领它掌握单一技能. 例如,InternW0由于它的"心智与行为"(Mind2Act)的结果而领先于端到端的领导板,然而它的"心智2Act"(Mind2Act)的成功率(3.0%)却低于"\\\\\\\\\\"0.5}(3.6%). 观察结果显示,两个家庭以不同的方式失败,因为最强的代理人保留任务状态,但难以保持接触,而端到端的政策执行实际动议,但保留很少任务状态。 一旦两个能力必须在一个工作流程中共同工作,两个家庭就会分崩离析。 当场景看起来不同时,VLA也损失了大部分内存,而Mind2Act工作流程随着难度的上升而最陡峭地倒塌.

blocks.en: MIND Can it remember what it has seen?
blocks.zh: 思维 它能记得它所看到的吗?

blocks.en: Agents can remember what they have seen and end-to-end policies seldom can, but no system reliably keeps track of objects that are moved. The Mind view asks a system to decide what to do from earlier observations, such as an item seen before, a rule learned from feedback, a layout, or the order of earlier operations. On this view, GPT-6 Astra leads by its widest margin and succeeds in 52.7% of Mind episodes (Table 4 ). By comparison, the other two agents reach only 11.0% and 4.3%, and the end-to-end policies stay between 0.9% and 5.4%. Even these few successes of the end-to-end policies come mostly at Easy , where there is least to remember, so these policies retain little task state of any kind.
blocks.zh: 特工们可以记住他们所看到的,并且端到端的政策很少能够做到,但是没有一个系统可靠地追踪被移动的物体. Mind观点要求一个系统来决定从先前的观察中应该做什么,比如前所见的项目,从反馈中吸取的规则,布局,或者早期操作的顺序. 根据这一观点,GPT-6 Astra以最宽的距离领先,并在52.7%的Mind事件(表4)中成功. 相比之下,其他两种药剂只达到11.0%和4.3%,端到端政策维持在0.9%至5.4%。 即使这些从端到端政策的少数成功也大多发生在Easy,

blocks.en: However, GPT-6 Astra does not remember equally well on every Mind task. It solves hidden-hazard navigation (S2) in every episode and card matching (M2) in 93%, and it also does well on button mapping (F1, 77%) and repeated-item recognition (E1, 73%). In all four tasks, what the agent remembers stays fixed once seen, and the agent uses it through button presses or simple placements. In contrast, the agent completes no episode of workpiece tracking (M1) or steamer-stack restoration (P2), and M1 remains unsolved by every system. Unlike the other four, these two tasks move the objects that the agent must remember. In M1 the covers are swapped while they hide the workpiece, and in P2 the baskets are unstacked and must be restacked in their original order. As a result, the agent must keep identities, positions and orders up to date while the robot itself lifts and moves the objects. Retrieving its earlier observations does not help here, because a stored image no longer shows where a swapped cover or a moved basket now is.
blocks.zh: 然而,GPT-6 Astra在每一项"心灵"任务上都记不得同样清楚. 它在每个插曲中解决了隐藏-危险导航(S2)和93%的卡片匹配(M2),在按钮映射(F1,77%)和重复项目识别(E1,73%)上也做得很好. 在全部四个任务中,代理记忆中一旦看到就固定下来,代理通过按下按钮或简单的放置来使用. 相形之下,毒剂没有完成任何一集的工匠跟踪(M1)或蒸汽机-stack修复(P2),而M1仍然被每个系统所未解. 与其他四个不同,这两个任务会移动代理必须记住的对象. 在M1中,被子在隐藏工件时被交换出被子;在P2中,被子被子被取出被子被取出被子被取出被子被子被取出被子被取出被子被取出被子被取出被子被取出被子被取出被子被取出被子被取出被子被取出被子被取出. 因此,在机器人本身抬起并移动物体的同时,特工必须不断更新身份,位置和订单. 获取其早期的观测结果在这里没有帮助,因为存储的图像不再显示一个被互换的封面或移动的篮子现在的位置.

blocks.en: P2 is also the only Mind task on which the end-to-end policies outperform all three agents, as four of the six policies complete some episodes and KinRT and π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} reach 15% and 14%. Because these policies retain little task state on the other Mind tasks, their P2 successes more likely come from practiced handling of the baskets than from memory. This also suggests that handling, and not memory alone, limits the agent on P2.
blocks.zh: P2也是Mind的唯一任务, 端到端政策比这三者都强, 由于这些政策在Mind的其他任务上保留了很少的任务状态,因此其P2的成功更可能来自于对篮子的实践处理而不是记忆. 这也说明,处理,而不仅仅是内存,限制了P2上的代理人.

blocks.en: ACT Can it execute precisely and on time?
blocks.zh: 青蒿素综合疗法 它能及时准确执行吗?

blocks.en: End-to-end policies act on time and the strongest agent also acts precisely, but neither family sustains control through contact. The Act view isolates physical execution, since each task states what to do and success depends on doing it precisely and on time. Every end-to-end policy performs best on this view, where the four VLAs reach 12.0 to 19.6% (Table 4 ), but GPT-6 Astra still leads at 39.0%. For the VLAs, timing is much easier than precision, as on average they succeed in 22 to 28% of the episodes on the four dynamic tasks but in only 4 to 18% on the six precision tasks.
blocks.zh: 端到端政策及时行动,最强的代理人也行动精确,但两个家族都没有通过接触维持控制. 该法将实际执行隔离开来,因为每项任务都规定要做什么,成功与否取决于行动是否准确和及时。 每个端到端政策都以这一观点表现得最好,四个VLA达到12.0%至19.6%(表4),但GPT-6 Astra仍然领先39.0%. 对于VLA来说,计时比精确度要容易得多,因为平均来说,在4个动态任务上,计时率在22%到28%的节目中成功,但在6个精确任务上则只有4%到18%成功.

blocks.en: GPT-6 Astra succeeds where the target can be read from the scene and reached in a few deliberate moves. It completes every resistance-adjustment episode (PR1) and 77 to 90% of the episodes on the three timed tasks DR1 to DR3, and it also reaches 43% on voltage setting (PR2), on which no end-to-end policy exceeds 3%. The end-to-end policies, by contrast, succeed where one practiced motion fits the task. On gate passage (DR3), KinRT, π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} and X-VLA succeed in 76 to 79% of episodes, close to the agent’s 80%, and X-VLA folds the cloth (PR4) in 64% of episodes, where the agent never succeeds.
blocks.zh: GPT-6 Astra成功从现场读取目标,并在少数故意动作中到达. 它完成3个定时任务DR1至DR3的每集阻力调整(PR1)和77%至90%的相片,在电压设定(PR2)上也达到43%,其中端到端政策不超过3%. 相比之下,在一项动议符合任务的情况下,端到端政策是成功的。 在门道(DR3)上,KinRT, ^ 0.5\pi_{0.5}和X-VLA在76到79%的剧集中成功,接近代理商的80%,而X-VLA在64%的剧集中折叠布(PR4),代理商从未成功.

blocks.en: Both kinds of success break down once a task requires sustained control, meaning that the robot must keep adjusting while it stays in contact with an object. Tasks such as DR4, PR3 and PR6 demand such control, because every small slip changes the state that the next motion must respond to. GPT-6 Astra completes none of the five tasks of this kind (DR4, PR3, PR4, PR5 and PR6), and its profile card shows that the failures occur during the contact itself (Appendix E.4 ). All 30 of its DR4 episodes are lost while the tray is lifted, and 21 of its 30 PR6 episodes end with dominoes knocked over during placement. Apart from PR4, which one practiced fold can cover, the end-to-end policies fare no better, and no system completes DR4, PR5 or PR6 in any of the 56,700 episodes. These failures point to missing correction during contact rather than to a misunderstanding of the task. Both families execute open-loop between observations, as the agent’s motion tools turn each target into a complete planned trajectory and each end-to-end policy executes a fixed number of actions from each chunk before predicting again (Appendix B ). A ball that starts to roll or a domino that starts to tip therefore goes uncorrected until the next observation.
blocks.zh: 这两种成功一旦任务需要持续控制就都会分解出来,这意味着机器人在与物体保持联系时必须不断调整. DR4,PR3和PR6等任务都要求这样的控制,因为每一个小滑子都会改变下个运动必须响应的状态. GPT-6 Astra没有完成这5个任务(DR4,PR3,PR4,PR5和PR6),其剖面卡显示失败发生在接触本身(Appendix E.4. 它的所有30个DR4分机在托盘被取出时丢失了,30个PR6分机中的21个以多米诺在放置时被撞倒而结束. 除了一个练习折叠可以覆盖的PR4之外,端到端的政策票价也没有更好的,在56,700集的任何一集中,没有一个系统完成DR4,PR5或PR6. 这些失败表明在接触过程中缺少纠正,而不是对任务的误解。 两个家庭在观察之间执行开放操作,因为代理人的动作工具将每个目标变成一个完整的计划轨迹,并且每个端到端政策在再次预测之前从每个块执行一个固定的动作数(附录B ). 因此,一个开始滚动的球或一个开始倾斜的多米诺会一直被修正到下一次观察.

(b) Random vs. Clean successes. For the six end-to-end policies, the ratio of successful Random episodes to successful Clean episodes on the same instances.
