blocks.en: MIND2ACT Do reasoning and execution work together?
blocks.zh: 头脑2ACT 推理与执行是否共同发挥作用?

blocks.en: Mind2Act workflows mostly end at their first steps, before reasoning and execution ever have to work together. The Mind2Act view chains dependent operations into one workflow, in which remembered information guides each action and each physical outcome decides what comes next. Table 4 and Fig. 7 a show that every system succeeds less often on this view than on Act. GPT-6 Astra drops from 52.7% on Mind and 39.0% on Act to 12.0% on Mind2Act, while the other two agents complete no Mind2Act episode. The end-to-end policies reach only 0.2 to 3.6%, close to their Mind rates and far below their Act rates. For example, X-VLA, the strongest VLA on Act, drops from 19.6% to 0.2%. This shows that strength on a single view does not carry over to workflows that need both, and that for the end-to-end policies the missing memory, rather than execution, sets the limit.
blocks.zh: 思维2 行为工作流程大多在最初阶段结束,然后推理与执行必须合作。 Mind2Act将依赖操作的链条查看成一个工作流程,其中记忆信息指导了每个动作,每个物理结果决定接下来会发生什么. 表4和图。 7,显示每个系统在这个观点上的成功率低于Act. GPT-6 Astra从Mind的52.7%和Mind2Act的39.0%下降到12.0%,而另外两个代理则完成不了Mind2Act插曲. 端到端政策只达到0.2%至3.6%,接近其Mind比率并远低于其Act比率. 例如,X-VLA,在Act上最强的VLA,从19.6%下降到0.2%. 这表明,在单一视图上的优势不会结转到需要两者兼有的工作流程上,对于端到端的政策,缺失的内存而不是执行设定了限制.

blocks.en: The few Mind2Act successes come from workflows that a system can finish with steps it already performs on the single views. GPT-6 Astra succeeds reliably only on conveyor meal assembly (CP01), in 60% of its episodes, and the picks in CP01 resemble the conveyor pickup of DR1, on which it succeeds in 77%. CP01 alone supplies 18 of its 36 Mind2Act successes, whereas the agent completes no episode of CP03, CP04, CP07, CP09 or CP10. The end-to-end policies, by contrast, succeed mostly at Easy , where a single order or item turns the workflow into little more than an Act task. For KinRT, π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} and G0.5, produce weighing (CP06) and CP01 supply 81 to 88% of all Mind2Act successes, and π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} succeeds in 8.6% of its Mind2Act episodes at Easy but in only 0.1% at Hard . These successes therefore reflect practiced steps rather than reasoning and execution working together.
blocks.zh: 为数不多的Mind2Act成功来自工作流程,一个系统可以用它在单个视图上已经执行的步骤来完成. GPT-6 Astra只在传送器餐食组装(CP01)上可靠地成功,在60%的节目中,CP01中的取出量与传送器的取出量(DR1)相类似,它以77%的得分成功. 仅CP01就提供了其36个Mind2Act成功案例中的18个,而代理则没有完成CP03,CP04,CP07,CP09或CP10的一集. 反之,端到端政策大多在Easy 成功,其中单个顺序或项目将工作流程变成仅仅是一个Act任务. 对于KinRT, 0.5\pi_{0.5}和G0.5, 产品重量(CP06)和CP01供应81%的Mind2Act成功率, 0.5\pi_{0.5} 其Mind2成功的8.6% 在Easy上演,但只有0.1%在Hard上演。 因此,这些成功反映的是实践步骤,而不是推理和执行合作。

blocks.en: Partial scores further indicate that most Mind2Act episodes fail early rather than near completion. For every system, the Mind2Act score exceeds the success rate by at most 1.5 points, and on CP07 and CP09 no system reaches even the first scored stage. For example, G0.5 never grasps a piece in 202 of its 300 CP07 episodes (Appendix E.4 ). Errors in the composition itself appear only when an episode gets that far, as when InternW0 switches on the heat before all ingredients are in the pot in 271 of its 300 CP04 episodes. This suggests that Mind2Act failures are driven less by the coordination of reasoning and execution than by single steps that reasoning or execution gets wrong. Reliable composition therefore first requires each capability to hold up at every step of a workflow, which no current system achieves.
blocks.zh: 部分分数还进一步表明,大多数"Mind2Act"(Mind2Act)的分出早于而非接近完成. 对于每个系统,Mind2Act的得分在最多1.5分时都超过了成功率,而在CP07和CP09上,甚至连第一个得分阶段都没有达到系统. 例如,G0.5在它的300个CP07集中的202集(Appendix E.4. 成份本身的出错仅在一集得到如此之多时才会出现,比如当InternW0在其300个CP04分集中的271集中,在所有成份被放入锅中之前在发热上开关. 这表明"Mind2Act"失败的驱动力较少于推理和执行的协调,而是由推理或执行错误的单一步骤所驱动. 因此,可靠的构成首先要求每个能力在工作流程的每个步骤都坚持下去,而目前系统并没有做到这一点。

blocks.en: APPEARANCE Does it hold up when the scene looks different?
blocks.zh: 申请 当场景看起来不同时,它能维持吗?

blocks.en: A change of appearance leaves the strongest agent’s memory largely intact, whereas the VLAs lose most of theirs. The Clean and Random settings use the same task instances, and Random only adds clutter and changes the table materials and the lighting, so comparing the two shows how much a change of appearance alone affects each system. Because all demonstrations were recorded in Clean scenes, Random scenes also look different from what the end-to-end policies saw in training. In overall score the change matters little, since no system gains or loses more than about three points (Appendix Table 11 ).
blocks.zh: 外观的改变使最强的特工的记忆基本完好无损,而VLA则失去了大部分的记忆. Clean and Random 设置使用相同的任务实例,而Random只添加了clutter并更改了表格材料和照明,因此将两者进行比较,可以显示单是外观变化对每个系统的影响有多大. 因为所有示威都记录在"清洁场景"中,"随机场景"也与"端到端"政策在训练中看到的不同. 总的来说,变化的分数不重要,因为没有任何系统增减超过3分(附录表11)。

blocks.en: The four fine-tuned VLAs, however, keep most of their Act successes and lose most of their Mind successes. They still complete 86 to 94% as many Act episodes in Random scenes as in Clean scenes, but only 28 to 41% as many Mind episodes (Fig. 7 b). Their Mind successes fall from 97 to 35 for KinRT, from 82 to 23 for π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} , from 41 to 17 for G0.5 and from 24 to 7 for X-VLA. An Act task shows its target in the current image, so the policy can still find it among new clutter and lighting. A Mind task instead requires the policy to decide from earlier observations, and in Random scenes those observations look unlike the demonstrations it was trained on. The VLAs therefore seem to remember how a scene looked in training rather than what it contained.
blocks.zh: 然而,四个经过精细调整的VLA保留了大部分的"行为"成功,并失去了大部分"心灵"成功. 他们仍然在随机场景中完成86%到94%的"Act"剧集和"Clean"剧集一样多,但只有"Mind"剧集的28到41%(图7b). 他们的心灵成功率从97分降到35分,从82分降到23分,从0.5分降到23分,从41分降到17分,从G0.5分降到24分降到7分,从X-VLA分到了24分。 Act任务在目前图像中显示了它的目标,因此政策仍然可以在新的杂乱和照明中找到它. 心灵任务要求政策从早期的观察中决定, 在随机场景中,这些观察与它所训练的演示不同。 因此,志愿军似乎记得在训练中一个场景的样子,而不是它包含的内容。

blocks.en: GPT-6 Astra behaves the other way round, as its Mind success rate only moves from 54.7% to 50.7% and its Mind2Act rate stays at 12.0%. It appears to remember what the scene contains, such as which items it has seen and where they are, and new textures, lighting and clutter do not change that. Its Act successes drop more, from 65 to 52 of 150, so for the agent a new appearance hurts execution more than memory. The two world-action models differ from each other, as InternW0 completes 83 Mind episodes in Random against 78 in Clean and keeps 93% of its Act successes, whereas FastWAM falls from 198 to 67 successes overall. For the world-action models, coping with a new appearance therefore depends on the individual model rather than on the model type.
blocks.zh: GPT-6 Astra则相反,因为其Mind成功率仅从54.7%升至50.7%,Mind2 行为率保持在12.0%。 它似乎记得这个场景包含什么,比如它见过哪些物品以及它们在哪里,新的纹理,照明和杂乱无章地改变不了这一点. 它的法案成功率下降更多,从150分中的65分下降到52分,因此对于特工来说,新的外表比记忆更会伤害处决. 两种世界行动模式互不相同,因为InternW0在"随机"中完成了83个"心灵"事件,在"清洁"中则完成了78个"心灵"事件,并保留了93%的作品. 行动成功,而快取机制则从198起降至67起。 因此,对于世界行动模型来说,应付新的外观取决于单个模型,而不是模型类型。

blocks.en: DIFFICULTY Does it hold up when the task gets harder?
blocks.zh: 困难 当任务变得更困难时,它会维持吗?

blocks.en: Harder levels hurt most where they add dependent operations, so Mind2Act workflows collapse while timed Act tasks barely change. Each harder level keeps the goal of a task and raises the demand its view is built around (Section 3.3 ), so Mind tasks give more earlier observations to decide from, Act tasks require more precise or timely execution, and Mind2Act tasks chain more dependent operations. Under these heavier demands every system succeeds less often, but four of the six end-to-end policies lose far more than the strongest agent. Over all tasks, GPT-6 Astra keeps 60% of its success rate from Easy to Hard , falling from 44.7% to 27.0%, whereas KinRT, π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} , G0.5 and InternW0 keep only 26 to 34%.
blocks.zh: 更硬的关卡在添加依赖操作时伤害最大,因此Mind2Act工作流程会崩溃,而定时的Act任务几乎没有改变. 每个更硬的层面都保留着任务的目标并提升需求,其观点是围绕(第3.3节)构建的,因此Mind任务给出了更早期的观察来决定从,Act任务需要更精确或更及时的执行,而Mind2Act任务链条更依赖操作. 在这些更重的要求下,每个系统的成功频率都较低,但六个端到端政策中的四个损失远大于最强的代理. 在所有任务中,GPT-6 Astra将60%的成功率从易到难从44.7%下降到27.0%,而KinRT, 0.5\pi\0.5},G0.5和实习生W0只保留了26%到34%。

blocks.en: This loss is not spread evenly across the views but concentrates where a harder level adds dependent operations. GPT-6 Astra falls from 64% to 44% on Mind and from 44% to 34% on Act, but from 26% to 3% on Mind2Act. This order follows the average length of the demonstrations, which is 23.9 seconds on Act, 58.5 seconds on Mind and 99.6 seconds on Mind2Act (Section 3.4.2 ). Longer tasks contain more operations that can fail, and each harder Mind2Act level adds more orders, shapes or balls, so a workflow fails as soon as one added operation fails. The end-to-end policies follow the same pattern, with Act holding up best. For example, InternW0 falls from 13.5% to 0.5% on Mind and from 8.0% to 0.3% on Mind2Act but still reaches 12.7% on Act at Hard . Robustness to appearance does not protect against this loss, as InternW0’s Mind rate and GPT-6 Astra’s Mind2Act rate barely change between Clean and Random but fall to 0.5% and 3% at Hard .
blocks.zh: 这种损失在各种观点中分布不均,而集中在较困难的层次会增加依赖性操作的地方。 GPT-6 Astra在Mind从64%下降到44%,在Act从44%下降到34%,但在Mind2Act从26%下降到3%. 这一顺序沿用了示威的平均长度,即23.9秒为Act,58.5秒为Mind,99.6秒为Mind2Act(第3.4.2节)。 较长的任务包含更多的可以失败的操作,而每个更硬的Mind2Act关卡会增加更多的命令,形状或球等,所以一旦一个添加的操作失败,一个工作流程就会失败. 端到端政策也遵循同样的模式,法案得到最好的支持。 例如,IndernW0从13.5%下降到0.5%,从8.0%下降到0.3%,但在Hard法案中仍然达到12.7%。 强壮的外表并不能防止这种损失,因为INW0的Mind率和GPT-6的Astra的Mind2Act率在Clean和Random之间几乎没有变化,但在Hard则下降到了0.5%和3%。

blocks.en: The timed Act tasks behave differently, because their harder levels mainly shorten the time in which the physical effect must happen. In DR2 the time allowed to press a lit button drops from 4.0 to 2.6 seconds, yet G0.5 still succeeds in 37, 39 and 34 of 100 episodes at the three levels. DR3 behaves the same way, as the gates stay open for less time while π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} succeeds in 76, 81 and 79 (Appendix Table 14 ). A policy with a practiced motion can simply perform it faster, and less time adds no operation that could go wrong. On the precision tasks, success can even depend on the fold a level asks for more than on its difficulty. X-VLA folds the cloth (PR4) in 97 Easy , 1 Medium and 94 Hard episodes of 100, so its learned motion seems to suit the rectangle and hexagon folds but not the diagonal fold of Medium . Harder levels therefore hurt most when they add dependent operations and much less when they mainly shorten the time.
blocks.zh: 定时的Act任务表现不同,因为它们的强度主要会缩短必须发生物理效果的时间. 在DR2中,允许按下点出按钮的时间从4.0降至2.6秒,而G0.5仍然在三等100集中的37集,39集和34集获得成功. DR3的表现方式相同,因为大门的开放时间较少,而 ^ 0.5\pi_{0.5}则在76,81和79中成功(附录表14.). 带有实践运动的政策可以简单地更快地执行,而更少的时间会增加不会出错的操作. 在精准的任务上,成功甚至可以取决于一个关卡所要求的折叠,而不是它的难度. X-VLA将布(PR4)折叠在97 Easy, 1 Medium和94 Hard series of 100中,因此其所学的运动似乎适合矩形和六角形的折叠而不适合中度的对角折叠. . 因此,在增加依赖性操作时,硬度受影响最大,在主要缩短时间时,则伤害更大。

blocks.en: Table 6 : Evaluation time and cost per system. Time per call is the mean duration of one API request of an agent or one action prediction of an end-to-end policy, run locally on one GPU; episode time is the mean wall-clock time of an episode, over all tasks and by view. API cost is the mean cost of an agent episode at the providers’ list prices and the cost per successful episode.
blocks.zh: 表6:每个系统的评价时间和费用。 每集通话时间为代理的API一次请求或一集动作预测一端到一端政策的平均持续时间,在一集GPU上局部运行;插曲时间为一集的平均时钟时间,覆盖所有任务和取景. API成本是代理剧集按提供者列表价格和每集成功成本的平均成本.

blocks.en: LATENCY & COST Would it keep up in real time, and what does each success cost?
blocks.zh: 拉丁美洲和加勒比费用 它能实时保持下去吗? 每一次成功都要花多少钱?

blocks.en: Agent episodes take longer and cost more as the workflow grows, while end-to-end policies respond within a fraction of a second. Simulation pauses while a model computes, so a timed task measures whether the right action is chosen and executed, not whether it is chosen in time. The pause hides a speed gap of one to nearly three orders of magnitude. As shown in Table 6 , an agent call takes 11.0 to 35.6 s, whereas an end-to-end policy takes 77.1 to 488.1 ms, and model requests fill 67 to 86% of an agent episode’s wall-clock time, against 2 to 29% for the end-to-end policies.
blocks.zh: 代理事件需要更长的时间,随着工作流程的增长成本会更高,而端到端的政策在一秒之内就响应了. 模拟在模型计算时会暂停,所以一个定时的任务衡量是否选择了正确的动作并执行,而不是是否及时选择. 暂停隐藏了1到近3个数量级的速度差距. 如表6所示,代理通话需要11.0到35.6秒,而端对端政策需要77.1到488.1毫秒,模型请求则需要填补代理剧集的67%到86%的时钟时间,而端对端政策需要2到29 % 。

blocks.en: For an agent, this time goes to deliberation and grows with how much a task leaves to be decided. GPT-6 Astra spends 16.8 minutes on an Act episode and 19.1 on a Mind episode, but 30.7 on a Mind2Act episode, where each physical outcome changes the next decision and its calls take longest (13.0 s against 9.2 s on Act), yet it completes only 12.0% of these workflows. A longer run does not by itself bring more success, as DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash is the slowest agent (96.1 minutes per episode) but completes only 6.6% of its episodes, against 34.6% for GPT-6 Astra. GPT-6 Astra, in turn, costs about twenty times as much per episode as the other two agents (USD 25.13 against USD 1.12 to 1.24 at list price), but because it succeeds far more often, its cost per success (USD 72.7) is only about four times that of DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash (USD 18.9).
blocks.zh: 对于一个代理人来说,这次要考虑,还要花多少时间来决定任务。 GPT-6 Astra在Act一集中花费了16.8分,在Mind一集中花费了19.1分,但在Mind2Act一集中花费了30.7分,其中每个物理结果改变下个决定,其通话时间最长(13.0秒对9.2秒),然而它只完成了这些工作流程的12.0%. 更长时间的运行本身并不能带来更大的成功,因为DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash是最慢的代理(每集96.1分),但只完成了6.6%的剧集,而GPT-6 Astra为34.6%. GPT-6 Astra的每集成本大约是其他两位代理的20倍(按单价计算,25.13美元比1.12美元比1.24美元高),但由于其成功次数多得多,其成功成本(72.7美元)仅为DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash(18.9美元)的4倍左右.

blocks.en: End-to-end policies are much faster, and X-VLA, for example, predicts in 153 ms, about seventy times faster than a GPT-6 Astra call. It finishes an Act episode in 6.5 rather than 16.8 minutes and reaches 19.6% on Act, the highest among end-to-end policies and half the agent’s 39.0%. Speed also varies among the end-to-end policies, as InternW0 succeeds slightly more often than KinRT (8.7% against 7.0%) but needs 19.2 rather than 4.8 minutes per episode. The agent’s lead on timed tasks depends on the paused clock, because many of GPT-6 Astra’s Act successes come from conveyor pickup (DR1, 77%) and light-cued response (DR2, 90%), while its mean request time on Act tasks (9.2 s) is more than three times the 2.6 s response window of the Hard light-cued task. In a real setting, the conveyor would keep moving and the light keep changing during that time.
blocks.zh: 端到端的政策要快得多,而以X-VLA为例,预测在153ms中,比GPT-6 Astra呼叫快了约70倍. 它以6.5分而不是16.8分完成一集《法案》,在《法案》中达到19.6%,这是端到端政策中最高的,是代理人的39.0%。 速度在端到端政策上也有所不同,因为InternW0的成功频率略高于KinRT(8.7%对7.0%),但每集需要19.2分而不是4.8分. 代理商在定时任务上的领先取决于被暂停的时钟,因为GPT-6 Astra法案的许多成功都来自传送器接车(DR1,77%)和轻接反应(DR2,90 %),而它对于Act任务的平均请求时间(9.2 s)是硬取光任务的2.6 s响应窗口的三倍多. 在真实的环境下,传送器会不停地移动,在这段时间里灯光会不停地变化.

blocks.en: REAL WORLD How far is each application domain from deployment?
blocks.zh: 真实世界 每个应用程序域距离部署有多远?

blocks.en: Domains built on pressing and placing reach at best about half of episodes, and kitchens and assembly remain far from deployment. Each task is built from a need in one of five application domains (Table 2 ), so the per-task results can also be read by domain ( Mean rows of Table 5 ). GPT-6 Astra succeeds in 53.3% of the companion and edutainment episodes and in 46.0% and 42.6% of those in manufacturing and logistics and in instrument and tool use, whose tasks mostly come down to pressing buttons, setting a slider or placing an item. It falls to 17.9% in home and food service and to 4.4% in assembly, where at least half of the tasks are Mind2Act workflows.
blocks.zh: 面积建立在按下和最多达到约一半的频率上,厨房和组装仍然远远没有部署。 每个任务都是从五个应用域之一的需要(表2)来构建的,因此每个任务的结果也可以被域来读取(表5的平均行). GPT-6 Astra在53.3%的伴奏和娱乐节目中成功,46.0%和42.6%在制造和物流以及仪器和工具使用中成功,他们的任务大多是按下按钮,设置滑动器或放置物品. 在家庭和食品服务方面,这一比率为17.9%,在装配方面为4.4%,其中至少一半的工作是Mind2Act工作流程。

blocks.en: The end-to-end policies rank the domains differently, as they do best in manufacturing and logistics (KinRT 20.9%), where conveyor pickup and gate passage repeat one practiced motion, and stay below 12% in every other domain. Four of the five domains each hold two tasks that no system completes, namely kitchen loading and cooking (CP03, CP04), workpiece tracking and tray carrying (M1, DR4), oriented stamping and whiteboard restoration (PR5, CP09), and the domino chain and bridge building (PR6, CP07).
blocks.zh: 端到端政策对领域排序不同,因为它们在制造和物流领域做得最好(KinRT 20.9%),其中传送器的接车和出闸通道重复了一个练习动作,在所有其他领域都保持在12%以下。 5个域中的4个域各自承担着没有系统完成的两个任务,即厨房装载和烹饪(CP03,CP04),工匠跟踪和托盘携带(M1,DR4),定向印花和白板修复(PR5,CP09)和多米诺链和桥梁建筑(PR6,CP07).

blocks.en: The best domain value, 53.3%, still means failing about every second attempt, so no domain is yet close to deployment even in simulation. Agents come closest in edutainment and manufacturing, end-to-end policies come closest in repetitive factory motions, and neither comes close in kitchens or assembly.
blocks.zh: 最好的域值53.3%,仍然意味着每一次尝试都失败,所以即使模拟中,还没有域接近部署. 代理商最接近于娱乐和制造,端到端政策也最接近于重复的工厂运动,厨房或装配中也不接近.

blocks.en: 5.3 Which System Suits Which Task
blocks.zh: 5.3 哪个系统适合哪个任务

blocks.en: The leaderboards and the analysis of Section 5.2 show how the systems rank and where each of them succeeds and fails. Together they show that agents and end-to-end policies currently handle different kinds of task demand.
blocks.zh: 领跑板和第5.2节的分析显示系统如何排列,每个系统在哪里成功和失败. 它们共同表明,代理人和端到端政策目前处理不同种类的任务需要。

blocks.en: A strong agent is suited to the steps of a task that turn on what was seen before and on what to do next. GPT-6 Astra remembers and reasons well (52.7% on Mind), keeps that memory when the scene changes, and solves tasks whose target can be read and reached in a few deliberate moves. Its limits lie in contact and timing. It completes none of the five contact-rich tasks, and its timed successes are measured with a simulator that waits for it. The other two agents use the same tools yet differ widely on Mind, so this profile is specific to the model.
blocks.zh: 一个强有力的代理人适合一项任务的步骤,该任务将开启前所见及下一步应做什么。 GPT-6 Astra记忆力和理由良好(在Mind上52.7%),当场景变化时保持了记忆,并解决了在几个故意动作中可以读取并达到目标的任务. 其极限在于接触和时机。 它没有完成五个富于接触的任务,它的定时成功用等待它的模拟器来衡量. 另外两种代理在"明德"上使用相同的工具,但在"明德"上差别很大,因此这个剖面图是针对模型的.

blocks.en: End-to-end policies are suited to steps that one practiced motion can cover. The four evaluated VLAs retain 86–94% of their Act successes under scene randomization, and each has its own strength: G0.5 on timed reactions, X-VLA on resistance adjustment and cloth folding, and KinRT and π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} on memory, where the VLAs show little. They retain almost no task state, so any step that depends on earlier information is better left to another system.
blocks.zh: 端到端政策适合一种实践动议可以涵盖的步骤。 四个被评价的VLA在场景随机化下保留了86-94%的Act成功率,每个都拥有自己的实力:G0.5在定时反应上,X-VLA在抵抗调整和布料折叠上,KinRT和Qπ 0.5\pi_{0.5}在记忆上,VLA显示很少. 它们几乎没有保留任务状态,因此任何依赖于更早信息的步骤最好留给另一个系统去.

blocks.en: InternW0 is the only end-to-end policy whose memory survives scene changes, and it nearly matches the agent on the blueprint task. It still follows its learned sequence without checking preconditions, as in cooking. FastWAM drops in both views under scene randomization, so this advantage is not inherent to world-action models.
blocks.zh: InternW0是唯一一个在场景变化中幸存的端对端政策,它与蓝图任务上的代理几乎吻合. 它仍然遵循其学到的顺序,不检查先决条件,就像烹饪一样。 FastWAM在场景随机化下在两种视图中都下降了,因此这种优势并不是世界动作模型所固有的.

blocks.en: Some demands are met by no system yet. No evaluated system succeeds on M1, and GPT-6 Astra completes no episode of P2. No system sustains contact under force (DR4, PR5 and PR6 are never completed), and none completes Mind2Act workflows reliably. GPT-6 Astra reaches 12.0% on Mind2Act, and no end-to-end policy exceeds 3.6%. Neither family yet covers both reasoning and execution.
blocks.zh: 有些要求尚未通过任何系统得到满足。 在M1上没有任何评价系统成功,而GPT-6 Astra则没有完成P2的一集. 没有系统在强制下维持接触(DR4,PR5和PR6从未完成),也没有系统可靠地完成Mind2Act工作流程. GPT-6 Astra在Mind2Act上达到12.0%,无端对端政策超过3.6%. 两个家庭都尚未包括推理和执行。

blocks.en: 6 Diagnostic Analysis
blocks.zh: 6 诊断分析

blocks.en: Success rates measure task completion, and task scores measure partial progress. But they cannot identify where or why a system fails within an episode, which is what model developers need to know. In this section, we examine where tasks fail, which errors recur across systems, and how these findings inform improvement priorities. Episode-level diagnosis and model profile cards (Section 6.1 ) connect failure patterns to task progress, budget use, and stopping decisions (Section 6.2 ), and the failure codes point to directions for improvement (Section 6.3 ). Inference latency, runtime and API cost are analyzed alongside success rates in Section 5.2 .
blocks.zh: 成功率衡量任务完成率,任务分数衡量部分进展. 但是他们无法识别一个系统在一集中在哪里或为什么失败,这是模型开发者需要知道的. 在本节中,我们审查哪些任务失败、哪些错误在系统之间反复出现,以及这些调查结果如何为改进优先事项提供参考。 Episode级诊断和模型剖面卡(第6.1节)将故障模式连接到任务进度,预算使用和停止决定(第6.2节),故障代码指向改进方向(第6.3节). 第5.2节结合成功率分析了推断延迟、运行时间和API费用。

blocks.en: 6.1 Diagnosis Harness and Model Profile Cards
blocks.zh: 6.1 诊断分析和模型简介卡

blocks.en: We classify failures by the first unrecoverable error identified in the episode, using 21 failure codes (Appendix E.1 ). Mind errors concern perception and task reasoning, Act errors concern physical execution, and composition errors concern using physical outcomes to guide subsequent actions. Three episode-level codes capture timeouts, stalls, and cases with insufficient evidence. The label follows the observed error, regardless of the task’s view. A Mind failure involves an error in perception or task reasoning. Examples include selecting the wrong object based on a misremembered order ( M-MEMORY ) and incorrectly predicting how the scene will change ( M-PREDICT ). An Act failure occurs when the system selects an appropriate action but executes it incorrectly. Examples include losing a grasp ( A-GRASP ) and executing the correct action too early or too late ( A-TIMING ). A composition failure occurs when the system proceeds without verifying a required outcome or fails to update its next action based on feedback. For example, the system may continue pressing the same button after the light cue changes ( C-NO-UPDATE ).
blocks.zh: 我们使用21个故障代码(Appendix E.1 .),按照剧集中识别出的第一个无法恢复的错误来分类故障. 思维错误涉及感知和任务推理,行为错误涉及实际执行,而构成错误则涉及利用物理结果来指导后续行动. 三集级代码记录超时,摊位,以及证据不足的案件. 标签跟随观察到的错误, 不管任务的观点如何 。 心智故障涉及感知或任务推理的错误. 例子包括根据错误的记忆顺序(M-MEmory)选择错误的对象,以及错误地预测场景将如何变化(M-PREDICT. 当系统选择了适当的动作但错误地执行时会发生行为失败. 例子包括失去把握(A-巨猿生存方案)和执行正确的行动太早或太迟(A-TIMING)。 当系统在没有核实所需结果的情况下继续运行,或未能根据反馈更新其下一项行动时,就会出现构成失败. 例如,系统可能在光提示变化后(C-NO-UPDATE .

blocks.en: The harness combines three layers of review as in Fig. 8 a. First, deterministic rules use scorer outputs and simulator events to isolate the failure or bound the step at which it occurred. For cases left open by rules, an LLM judge inspects the video and action or tool-call history without overturning rule-based verdicts, flagging ambiguous cases as uncertain. Finally, human reviewers settle the cases the judge marks as uncertain. Fig. 8 shows the workflow on an illustrative example, and Appendix E.4 reports the results of this procedure for every failed episode of three representative systems.
blocks.zh: 如图8 a. 第一,决定规则使用计分器输出和模拟事件来隔离失败或约束其发生的步骤。 对于按规则开放的案件,LLM法官检查录像和行动或工具调用历史,而不推翻基于规则的判决,将模糊不清的案件标榜为不确定。 最后,人类审查人员解决法官认为不确定的案件。 图8以一个说明性的例子显示工作流程,附录E.4报告了三个代表性系统每一出故障都采用这一程序的结果。

blocks.en: Figure 8 : Failure diagnosis on an example profile card. An illustrative example, the same as in Fig. 9 and on the project website; the measured cards of three representative systems are in Appendix E.4 . (a) Three-layer diagnosis. The workflow as a funnel: in this example, the rule layer settles about a third of the failed episodes, and the rest pass to the LLM judge and, where it is uncertain, to the human check. (b) Beyond the success rate. The example end-to-end policy rarely completes these three tasks, and most of its failures on each task occur at a single early step. (c) Across all failures. The card follows the failed episodes from the step at which each first breaks to its failure code.
blocks.zh: 图8:实例简介卡上的失败诊断. 一个与图9和项目网站一样的示例;三个代表性系统的计量卡在附录E.4中。 (a) 三级诊断。 作为漏斗的工作流程:在这个例子中,规则层解决了大约三分之一的失败事件,而剩下的则通过LLM法官,在不确定的情况下通过人检查. (b) 超越成功率。 举例来说,端到端政策很少能完成这三项任务,它在每个任务上的大部分失败都发生在一个单一的早期. (c) 在所有失败中。 该卡跟随失败的片段,从每次第一次破解时的分出到失败代码.

blocks.en: A model profile card summarizes the failure profile of a single system. Fig. 8 walks through the diagnosis of an illustrative end-to-end policy, and Fig. 9 shows the full card format with illustrative numbers. The cards of three representative evaluated systems are given in Appendix E.4 .
blocks.zh: 一个模型剖面卡总结了一个单一系统的故障剖面. 图8走遍了对说明性端到端政策的诊断,图9显示了带有说明性数字的全卡格式. 附录E.4列出了三个受评价的代表性系统的卡片。

Where failures break and Which side failed give the step at which failed episodes first break down and whether Mind , Act or their composition failed. First failures and Where tasks break give the most frequent failure codes and where typical tasks stop. Model gives a four-letter behavioral profile (Appendix E.6 ). Capability profile and Under pressure give the success of each task at Easy, Medium and Hard, grouped by capability and view, and the success rate by difficulty. What could help turns the codes into directions for improvement. The numbers are an illustrative example; the measured cards of three representative systems are given in Appendix E.4 .

blocks.en: 6.2 Failure Patterns of the Evaluated Systems
blocks.zh: 6.2 评价系统的失败模式

blocks.en: We read the measured cards of G0.5, InternW0 and GPT-6 Astra (Appendix E.4 ), together with the run logs of the agents.
blocks.zh: 我们阅读了G0.5、InternW0和GPT-6 Astra(附录E.4)的测量卡,以及代理商的运行日志。

blocks.en: Physical execution is the largest diagnosed failure group in all three systems, accounting for 41.4% of G0.5’s failures, 37.2% of InternW0’s, and 55.3% of GPT-6 Astra’s. GPT-6 Astra’s failures are particularly concentrated in execution, whereas G0.5 and InternW0 also show substantial perception and reasoning failures, at 27.7% and 32.8%, respectively; 6–11% of each system’s failures occur while closing the loop. These proportions refer to the first unrecoverable error identified in each failed episode. The rule layer alone would overstate Mind-side errors for the end-to-end policies (Appendix Table 17 ), because scorer records reveal a misremembered item more readily than video reveals a motor fault. A card therefore combines the layers.
blocks.zh: 实际处决是所有三种系统中最大的确诊失败群体,占G0.5失败的41.4%,实习W0失败的37.2%,占GPT-6 Astra失败的55.3%. GPT-6 Astra的失败特别集中在执行上,而G0.5和InternW0也表现出了实质性的认知和推理失败,分别为27.7%和32.8%;每个系统的失败有6-11%发生在关闭循环时. 这些比例是指在每个失败的插曲中识别出的第一个无法恢复的错误. 单是规则层会过度描述端到端政策的Mind-side错误(附录表17),因为计分器记录显示一个记错的项目比视频显示一个运动故障更容易. 因此卡片结合了地层.

blocks.en: The dominant execution errors differ across systems. Failed or lost grasps are the most frequent errors for G0.5 and GPT-6 Astra, with 1,324 and 120 cases, while fine-control errors lead InternW0’s profile with 1,132 cases. The two end-to-end policies also record 924 and 1,011 memory failures. These profiles identify distinct priorities: grasp reliability for G0.5 and GPT-6 Astra, fine control for InternW0, and task-state retention for both end-to-end policies.
blocks.zh: 主要的执行错误因系统而异。 失败或失去把握是G0.5和GPT-6 Astra最常出错,有1,324起和120起;而精细控制出错则导致InternW0的剖析出1,132起. 两个端到端政策也记录了924和1,011个内存故障. 这些简介确定了不同的优先事项:掌握G0.5和GPT-6 Astra的可靠性,对InternW0的精细控制,以及两端政策的任务状态保留。

blocks.en: The dominant failure also varies by task, even within the same system. For G0.5, 202 of 300 bridge-building episodes (CP07) fail to grasp a construction piece (Fig. 12 ), making object acquisition the main obstacle to further progress. In light-cued pressing (DR2), however, 90 of 190 failures involve a misread light ( M-PERCEIVE ) and 88 involve a response that is not updated after the light changes ( C-NO-UPDATE ). Only eight concern the press itself or its timing. In incremental meal orders (P1), memory errors account for 210 of G0.5’s 300 failed episodes and 245 of InternW0’s 298 failed episodes.
blocks.zh: 主要的失败也因任务而异,即使在同一个系统内也是如此. 对于G0.5来说,300个建桥事件(CP07)中的202个未能把握到一个构件(图12),使物体获取成为了进一步进步的主要障碍. 然而,在轻发压(DR2)中,190起故障中有90起涉及误读光(M-PERCEIVE),88起涉及在轻发后没有更新的响应(C-NO-UPDATE.). 只有八个涉及新闻界本身或其时机。 在增量餐单(P1)中,内存错误占了G0.5的300个失败分集的210个,以及InternW0的298个失败分集的245个.

blocks.en: No evaluated system completes whiteboard restoration (CP09) or bridge building (CP07), and failures on such workflows often occur before their reasoning stages are reached. On CP09, 299 of 300 G0.5 episodes stop before board removal. GPT-6 Astra fails during the lift in all 30 tray-carrying (DR4) episodes (Fig. 14 ). Zero success on these tasks is therefore consistent with early physical bottlenecks rather than failures in downstream planning or repair. Most episodes fail in Mind or Act before closed-loop composition is tested.
blocks.zh: 没有经过评价的系统可以完成白板修复(CP09)或桥梁建筑(CP07),此类工作流程的故障往往在达到推理阶段之前发生. 在CP09上,300个G0.5集中的299集在棋盘取出前停止. GPT-6 Astra在所有30个托盘承载(DR4)集(图14.)的起重过程中失败. 因此,这些任务没有取得任何成功,这与早期的实际瓶颈是一致的,而不是在下游规划或修理方面的失败。 多数事件在Mind或Act中失败后,闭路组分才会被测试.

blocks.en: Under the same decision budget, the agent logs show distinct termination patterns (Appendix Table 18 ). Gemini-4-Argon voluntarily stops in 829 of 900 episodes and uses approximately 33 decisions per episode. DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash uses 111.8 decisions on average, voluntarily stops in 385 episodes, and exhausts the decision and physics budgets in 286 and 94 episodes, respectively. GPT-6 Astra averages 79.6 decisions per episode. It voluntarily stops in 460 episodes, and only one of them succeeds, a gate-passage episode (DR3) whose task was already complete when it stopped. The other 459 account for 77.9% of its 589 failed episodes, and in 264 of them the agent has used no more than 100 of the 150 allowed decisions. Among these 459 stops, the first unrecoverable error is attributed to execution in 289 cases, perception or reasoning in 127, and composition in 28. The remaining 15 cases fall outside these three capability groups.
blocks.zh: 根据同一决定预算,代理记录显示不同的终止模式(附录表18)。 双子座-4-Argon在900集的829集中自愿停放,每集使用约33个决定. DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash平均使用111.8个决策,自愿停用385个集,并分别用完286个集和94个集的决定和物理预算. GPT-6 Astra平均每集79.6个决定. 它在460集中自愿停放,其中只有一集成功,一集出道口(DR3),当它停放时任务已经完成. 另外459起事件占其589起失败事件的77.9%,其中264起事件代理使用量不超过150起允许决定中的100起. 在这459站中,第一个无法挽回的错误被归结为289个执行案,127个认知或推理,28个组成. 其余15个案件不属于这三个能力小组。

blocks.en: These results distinguish resource limits from the errors that prevent task completion. DeepSeek frequently exhausts its budget. GPT-6 Astra shows a different pattern: many unsuccessful episodes end with substantial decision budget remaining, and execution errors dominate its voluntary stops, often after its motion planner rejects the requested poses. For episodes affected by execution errors, additional decisions are useful only if they enable effective retries or corrective actions (Table 7 ).
blocks.zh: 这些结果区分了资源限制和妨碍完成任务的错误。 DeepSeek经常耗尽预算。 GPT-6 Astra显示了一种不同的模式:许多不成功的事件以大量决策预算还剩而告终,执行错误在它的自愿停站中占据了主导地位,这往往发生在其动议策划者拒绝要求的姿势后. 对于受执行错误影响的事件,额外决定只有在能够有效重复或纠正行动的情况下才有用(表7)。

blocks.en: 6.3 From Failure Codes to Directions
blocks.zh: 6.3 从失败代码到方向

blocks.en: A diagnosis helps a model developer only if it says what to change, and the profiles narrow broad improvement goals to specific behaviors. Because each failure code names the step and the side of the loop at which an episode broke, a group of codes points to the capability that most needs to improve. An evaluation speaks most directly to two levers that a developer can adjust without redesigning the model. One is the training data of an end-to-end policy. The other is the harness of an agent, that is, the tools and control loop through which it acts. Table 7 maps the three groups of the profile card, and the breakpoints shared by all of them, to such directions. The paragraphs below give the evidence behind each.
blocks.zh: 一种诊断只有当模型开发者说出要改变什么时才会帮助他,而剖面将广义的改进目标缩小到特定的行为上. 由于每个故障代号都取出一个分集断裂的分步和回路的一面来命名,一组代号就指出了大多数需要改进的能力. 一项评价最直接地谈到两个杠杆,开发者可以在不重新设计模型的情况下进行调整. 一是端到端政策的培训数据. 另一个是利用一种物剂,即它通过的工具和控制循环。 表7将剖面卡的三组,以及所有它们共享的断点映射到这些方向. 以下各段提供了每一段背后的证据。

blocks.en: Table 7 : Directions for improvement by failure group. Grouped as on the profile card ( Mind , Act and Composition ). The directions concern the training data of end-to-end policies and the harness of agents. Evidence is from the measured cards of Appendix E.4 and the results of Section 5 .
blocks.zh: 表7:按失败群体分列的改进方向。 组合为概况卡(Mind, Act and Constitution). 指导涉及端到端政策的培训数据以及代理人的利用。 证据取自附录E.4所测量的卡片和第5节的结果。

blocks.en: Misremembered information is the most frequent Mind -side code of both measured end-to-end policies, with 924 failures of G0.5 and 1,011 of InternW0, and the VLAs lose 59–72% of their Mind successes when the scene is randomized (Section 5.2 ). These failures point to maintaining task-relevant identities, order, and progress across operations, and to recognizing an item under a new appearance. Closing this gap calls for data that stress what the failures expose, with varied scene appearance and longer gaps between the moment information is shown and the moment it is needed.
blocks.zh: 被误记的信息是最常见的Mind - side代码,既衡量了端到端政策,又发现有924个故障,分别为G0.5和InternW0的1,011;而VLA则在场景被随机处理时损失了59-72%的Mind成功率(第5.2节). 这些失败表明,在各种业务中保持与任务相关的身份、秩序和进展,并在新的外观下确认一个项目。 缩小这一差距需要数据,强调失败所暴露的内容,在显示信息之时和需要信息之时之间,场景外观各异并存在较长的差距。

blocks.en: Failed or lost grasps account for 1,324 failures of G0.5 and fine-control errors for 1,132 of InternW0. On bridge building (CP07), 202 of 300 G0.5 episodes never grasp a piece. G0.5’s frequent grasp failures motivate training and control changes that improve contact acquisition and object retention. InternW0’s fine-control errors motivate closer examination of action resolution and feedback during manipulation. Responses must also fall within the short windows of timed tasks such as the light-cued button (DR2) and the cyclic gates (DR3). On DR3, most failures of the two end-to-end policies come from the withdrawal after delivery rather than from the gate timing. The arm is still inside the gate corridor when the gate closes, or touches the gate while it closes. Demonstrations can be weighted toward these segments, with more variation in object pose, contact and timing, instead of being spread evenly over whole episodes.
blocks.zh: 失败或失去把握是G0.5的1,324次失败和1,132次实习W0. 在桥梁建筑(CP07)上,300个G0.5集中的202集从未抓住一出. G0.5频繁的抓取失败促使培训和控制改变,从而改进接触获取和保留对象。 实习生 W0的精细控制错误促使人们更仔细地检查动作解析和操纵过程中的反馈. 反应也必须属于被定时的任务的短窗口,如轻接按钮(DR2)和循环门(DR3). 在 DR3 上,两种端对端政策的失败大多出自交货后退出而非出闸时间. 大门关上后,手臂还留在大门走廊内,或者在关上时触摸大门. 示范可以向这些部分加权,在物体的姿势、接触和时间方面有更大的变化,而不是在整个情况下均匀分布。

blocks.en: InternW0 has 761 precondition failures, 271 of them on cooking (CP04), where it switches on the heat before all ingredients are in the pot. Each step is executed, but its outcome is not checked before the next one starts. Such failures call for checking whether the required physical state has been achieved before proceeding, and repairing a step that failed. The scripted demonstrations show only steps that succeed, so a policy never sees a failed step followed by its repair. Recovery demonstrations can begin at frequently observed failures, such as a slipped grasp or an incomplete placement, and show how to restore progress.
blocks.zh: INNW0有761个先决条件故障,其中271个发生在烹饪(CP04)上,它在所有成分入锅之前在发热上切换. 每一步都执行,但其结果在下一步开始前不会被检查. 这种失败要求检查在进行之前是否达到了所要求的物理状态,并修复一个失败的步骤。 脚本演示只显示成功步骤,因此一项政策从不看到一个失败步骤,然后进行修复. 复原示范可以从经常观察到的失败开始,例如抓不稳或安置不完整,并表明如何恢复进展。

blocks.en: These diagnoses also guide data collection. Because an end-to-end policy learns its behavior from demonstrations, the cards show where new data for it should be built. On whiteboard restoration (CP09), 299 of 300 G0.5 episodes end before the board is lifted off its stand, so the later stages of the task are never reached. Adding full-length demonstrations would spend most of their steps on later stages, which the policy almost never reaches. Demonstrations constructed around the breakpoint instead, starting from the states in which episodes stop and from perturbed states near them, concentrate the training data where the policy fails.
blocks.zh: 这些诊断还指导了数据收集。 由于一端到端的政策从演示中学习到它的行为,卡片显示它的新数据应该建在哪里. 在白板还原(CP09)上,300个G0.5集中的299集在板子被解除起立前结束,因此任务后期从未达到. 增加全长的示威将大部分时间花在后期,而这项政策几乎从未达到。 相反,从停止事件发生的州开始,从附近扰动的州开始,围绕断点进行示威,将培训数据集中在政策失败的地方。

blocks.en: For agents, the same codes also point to the harness. GPT-6 Astra breaks down mostly during execution and often stops after its motion planner rejects the requested poses (Section 6.2 ), so finer motion tools and a retry step before stopping come first. Tool feedback should help distinguish an ineffective request from a completed operation and support an appropriate retry or alternative action. The harness can also return the outcome of each step and require a check before the next one, which addresses composition failures. It can also keep a record of earlier failures, so that an agent recognizes a breakpoint it has met before.
blocks.zh: 对于特工来说,同样的代码也指向了绳子. GPT-6 Astra大多在行刑期间分解出来,通常在其运动计划者拒绝所请求的姿势后停止(第6.2节),因此更精细的动作工具和一个再试步骤才先停止. 工具反馈应有助于将无效请求与已完成的操作区分开来,并支持适当的重试或替代行动。 牵引装置还可以还原每个步骤的结果并需要在下一个步骤之前进行检查,以解决组成故障. 也可以保存早期失败的记录,这样一个代理人就能识别它之前遇到的断点.

blocks.en: 7 Limitations and Future Directions
blocks.zh: 7 限制和未来方向

blocks.en: 7.1 Limitations
blocks.zh: 7.1 限制

blocks.en: Each view is a set of tasks, not an intervention on one system. A Mind task still requires routine manipulation, an Act task still requires the robot to perceive its cue, and the Mind2Act workflows are longer than the single-view tasks and differ from them in content (Section 5.2 ). A low Mind2Act result therefore cannot yet be separated from the effect of a longer horizon or of an early execution error. The diagnosis harness attributes failures within each episode, where rules settle 22 to 38% of the failures of the three diagnosed systems and the LLM judge, with human review of uncertain cases, attributes the rest.
blocks.zh: 每一种观点都是一组任务,而不是对一个系统的干预. Mind任务仍需要日常操控,Act任务仍需要机器人感知它的提示,而Mind2Act工作流程比单视图任务长并与其在内容上有所不同(第5.2节). 因此,一个较低的Mind2Act结果还不能与更长的视野或早期执行出错的影响相分离. 诊断方法将失败归结于每集中的失败,其中规则解决了被诊断出的三个系统的22%至38%的失败,而LLM法官则将不确定病例的人文审查归结于其余的.

blocks.en: Simulation pauses during inference, so timed tasks test whether an action is chosen and timed correctly in simulation time, not in real time (Section 5.2 ). The agents also receive an inverse-kinematics and motion-planning service and four times the physics budget of the end-to-end policies, and they are not trained on the benchmark. All three agents use the same fixed harness, so the results do not show what a model would achieve with its own tools, controllers or memory. We therefore rank agents and end-to-end policies on separate leaderboards and treat the lead of the strongest agent as a result under the paused clock rather than as real-time ability.
blocks.zh: 模拟在推论中会暂停,所以定时的任务会测试一个动作是否在模拟时间中被选择并正确定时,而不是实时(第5.2节. 物剂还获得反相和运动规划服务,并获得端到端政策的物理预算的4倍,它们没有接受基准训练. 所有这三种代理都使用相同的固定吊带,因此结果没有显示一个模型会用自己的工具,控制器或内存实现什么. 因此,我们把代理人和端到端政策排到不同的领导板上,并将最强的代理人的铅作为暂停时钟下的结果,而不是作为实时能力.

blocks.en: The results cover three agents, four VLAs and two WAMs, and they include no hybrid or memory-augmented system. This is enough to compare the two families but too few for a broader analysis, for example of how model size, training data or architecture shapes the results on Mind, Act and Mind2Act. Each agent is also evaluated on only ten episodes per task and level, so its results by difficulty level are coarse. Some episodes were run again after infrastructure failures (Appendix B ).
blocks.zh: 结果包括了3个剂,4个VLA和2个WAM,它们没有包含混合或内存增强系统. 这足以比较两个家庭,但对于更广泛的分析却太少了,例如模型大小、培训数据或架构如何塑造关于Mind、Act和Mind2Act的结果。 每个代理也只按每个任务和级别评价出十集,因此其难度等级的结果粗糙. 一些事件在基础设施故障后再次被运行(附录B.

blocks.en: All tasks are tabletop manipulation tasks in simulation on one bimanual platform with parallel grippers, and each task and level uses one fixed English instruction. Other embodiments and settings, such as dexterous hands, mobile manipulation, navigation and humanoid robots, are not yet covered. The Random setting changes appearance over a wide range and is not meant to model a deployment scene. Each capability category contains between one and six tasks, which is too few to support claims about a single category. How the results in simulation relate to results on the physical robot has not yet been measured.
blocks.zh: 所有任务都是平板电脑操作任务,在一个双人平台上模拟,并带有平行的抓取器,每个任务和关卡都使用一个固定的英语指令. 其他的浮雕和设置,如有节制的手,移动操纵,导航和人造机器人等尚未被覆盖. Random设置改变外观范围很广,并非意在模拟部署场景. 每个能力类别包含1至6个任务,这些任务太少,无法支持关于一个类别的索赔。 模拟结果如何与物理机器人上的结果相关,尚未被测量.

blocks.en: 7.2 Future Directions
blocks.zh: 7.2 未来方向

blocks.en: We group the planned extensions into four directions that match the panels of Fig. 10 , and the leaderboards will be updated with new systems, tasks and results as these extensions are added.
blocks.zh: 我们把计划中的扩展分成四个方向,与图10的面板相匹配,随着这些扩展的加入,领导板将会以新的系统,任务和结果来更新.

blocks.en: The current views show where a system fails, and the next step is to show why. On the Mind2Act tasks, an oracle for Mind will supply the task state that would otherwise have to be remembered or inferred, and an oracle for Act will let a system call scripted skills for the physical operations. The gain from each oracle shows how much that capability contributes, and the gap that remains with both oracles shows the cost of composition. Each Mind2Act workflow will also be paired with the Mind and Act tasks that share its demands, and progress will be reported for each stage as the share of episodes that pass it among those that reach it, which removes the effect of horizon length. Matched pairs of runs that start from the same task state and differ only in whether the system receives feedback on a grasp, a placement or a contact will then measure how much the outcome of an action guides the next decision.
blocks.zh: 当前视图显示一个系统失败之处,下一步是显示原因. 关于Mind2Act任务,Mind的甲骨文会提供否则必须被记住或推断的任务状态,而Act的甲骨文会让系统调用脚本技能进行物理操作. 从每个甲骨文中获得的收益表明这种能力贡献了多少,与两个甲骨文仍然存在的差距表明组成成本. 每个思维2 动作工作流程还将与分享其要求的"明德"和"明德"任务搭配,每个阶段的进展都会作为通过它的事件在到达它的事件中的份额来报告,这消除了视野长度的影响. 匹配的一对运行从同一个任务状态开始,仅在系统是否收到关于抓取,放置或接触的反馈时,才会测量一个动作的结果指导下个决定的多少.

blocks.en: The leaderboards will cover more systems and settings, so that the comparison between the two families no longer rests on one fixed setup. The task suite will also grow beyond tabletop bimanual manipulation to dexterous hands, mobile manipulation, navigation and humanoid robots, so that the three views can be tested on other embodiments. Human teleoperation and a scripted expert acting through each interface will give every task a reachable upper bound, and a version of the protocol that adds inference time to the simulation clock will show how much of the agents’ result on timed tasks remains in real time. A sandbox setting with its own leaderboard will let an agent bring its own harness, which runs in an isolated container with access only to the cameras, the robot state and joint-level control. The evaluated systems will extend to memory-augmented end-to-end policies, which test whether the weak memory of the VLAs comes from their architecture, and to hybrid systems that pair a language-model planner with a learned executor, which test whether combining the memory of the best agent with the practiced motions of the VLAs closes part of the gap. Repeated runs of the same instances will show how much results vary, together with the time and cost of each evaluation, and the difficulty levels of tasks on which the levels currently make no difference will be recalibrated.
blocks.zh: 领导板将覆盖更多的系统和设置,这样两个家庭之间的比较就不再依赖于一个固定的设置. 任务套装还将从平板电脑双人操纵到可调解手,可移动操纵,导航和人造机器人,使这三种观点能够被测试到其他的活化. 人类电信操作和一位脚本专家通过每个接口行事,将给每个任务一个可达到的上行界限,一个给模拟时钟增加推断时间的协议版本将显示特工在定时任务上有多少结果仍然实时存在. 装有自己前导板的沙盒设置,会让一个特工带出自己的被子,它运行在一个孤立的容器中,只能进入相机,机器人状态和联合控制层. 被评价的系统将延伸至内存增强的端到端政策,该政策测试VLAs的弱内存是否出自其架构,以及将语言-模型规划器与已学习的执行器组合在一起的混合系统,该混合系统将测试最佳代理的内存是否与VLAs所实践的运动相结合,从而将部分差距拉近. 重复重复进行同样的情况将显示成果的差别有多大,以及每次评价的时间和费用,而且目前水平没有变化的任务的困难程度将重新调整。

blocks.en: The diagnosis will move from explaining failures to guiding improvement. It will cover every evaluated system rather than three representative ones, and its rules and prompts will be released. The current harness reports only the first unrecoverable error of each episode, which shows where an episode breaks but not what happens after it. The diagnosis will therefore trace the whole course of a failed episode and record multiple breakpoints, including how an early error leads to later ones and whether the system notices a mistake and recovers from it. Episodes will also start from verified intermediate states of the scripted demonstrations, so that each stage of a workflow is measured even when an earlier stage fails. A developer can then change a model in response to its profile card and evaluate the new model on the same instances to check whether the change helped.
blocks.zh: 诊断将从解释失败转向指导改进。 它将涵盖每个经过评价的系统,而不是三个有代表性的系统,其规则和提示将公布。 目前的被套接力只报告了每集的第一个无法恢复的错误,它显示了一集断裂的地方,而并没有说明之后发生的事情. 因此,诊断会追溯出一出失败的一集的整个过程并记录出多个断点,包括早期出错如何导致后一断点,系统是否注意到错误并从中恢复. Episode也会从已核实的脚本演示的中间状态开始,这样即使一个更早的阶段失败,一个工作流程的每个阶段都会被测量. 然后,开发商可以针对其配置卡修改一个模型,并在相同实例上评价新模型,以检查该修改是否有帮助.

blocks.en: The last direction tests whether the findings hold outside simulation. Mind2Act World will add real-robot experiments in which its tasks are mapped to physical counterparts, starting with Mind2Act tasks such as CP02 and CP04 and extending to a wider set of tasks, so that the Mind, Act and Mind2Act results can be verified on physical hardware. The same tasks will also be paired with similar tasks in other simulators, which shows how much of the failure analysis carries across platforms.
blocks.zh: 最后一个方向是测试结果是否维持在模拟之外。 思维2 Act World将增加实相机器人实验,将它的任务映射到物理对应物,从Mind2Act任务如CP02和CP04开始,并扩展到更广泛的一组任务,这样就可以在物理硬件上验证Mind,Act和Mind2Act的结果. 同样的任务也会与其他模拟器中类似的任务配对,这显示了故障分析中有多少内容可以跨平台.

blocks.en: 8 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 8 结论

blocks.en: We introduce Mind2Act World , a benchmark that measures what a robot retains and decides, how well it executes, and whether the two hold together when each physical outcome sets the next decision. Thirty tasks in three views, each with three difficulty levels and paired Clean and Random scenes, yield 180 configurations, all scored from physical outcomes by the same evaluator for agents and end-to-end policies.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了Mind2Act World, 这个基准用来衡量机器人保留和决定什么, 它的执行如何, 以及当每个物理结果设定下一个决定时, 两者是否一致。 三种观点共30个任务,每个任务有3个难度级,并配对"干净"和"随机"的场景,产生180个配置,均由同一评价员对代理和端到端政策的物理结果得分.

blocks.en: Our evaluation of three agents, four VLAs, and two WAMs over 56,700 episodes yields three main findings. First, the strongest agent leads every view without task-specific training, operating under a paused clock and with a motion planner, while the four fine-tuned VLAs have similar Overall success rates and differ mainly in the tasks they handle best. Second, single-view ability does not carry over to Mind2Act tasks: the best system falls from 52.7% on Mind and 39.0% on Act to 12.0% on Mind2Act, and no end-to-end policy exceeds 3.6%. Third, the VLAs are limited even before composition, by memory that mostly disappears when the scene changes and by the first physical contact of the longer workflows. Eight of the thirty tasks are completed by no system.
blocks.zh: 我们对3名特工,4名VLA和2名WAM的评价超过56700集,得出了3个主要结论. 首先,最强的特工带领每个没有任务特定训练的视图,在被暂停的时钟下运行并配备了运动计时器,而四个精细的VLA则有着相近的整体成功率并主要在他们处理最出色的任务上有所不同. 其次,单视能力不会延续到Mind2Act的任务:最好的系统从Mind的52.7%和Mind2Act的39.0%下降到12.0%,端到端政策没有超过3.6%. 第三,VLA甚至在组成之前都受到限制,因为内存大多在场景变化后消失,以及较长的工作流程的第一次物理接触. 30项任务中有8项没有系统完成。

blocks.en: Wang Yangming held that knowing and acting are one. In current embodied systems, they remain separate abilities, unevenly developed and not yet joined. Mind2Act World makes the distance between them measurable. The interventions, references and additional systems described in Section 7 are our next steps toward explaining it.
blocks.zh: 王阳明认为,认识和行为是一体的. 在目前的系统中,它们仍然是各自独立的能力,发展不均,尚未加入。 思维2 行动世界使得它们之间的距离可以衡量。 第7节所描述的干预、参考和补充系统是我们为解释它而采取的下一步步骤。

blocks.en: A.1 Simulation Platform
blocks.zh: A.1 模拟平台

blocks.en: Mind2Act World runs in Isaac Sim with two ARX X5 arms and parallel grippers. A fixed head camera and two wrist cameras provide RGB images. Physics is stepped at 120 Hz and robot targets are updated at 30 Hz. Simulation pauses while a model computes, so task deadlines are measured in simulation time and cost in wall-clock time. Each task is defined by a specification that fixes the scene, the objects and mechanisms, the per-level parameters, the episode randomization and the evaluator. Changing the level or the seed changes only these parameters, never the objective or the scoring rule.
blocks.zh: Mind2Act World在艾萨克西姆(Isaac Sim)运行,拥有两只ARX X5臂和平行的抓取手. 一台固定头相机和两台手腕相机提供RGB图像. 物理学被踩到120赫兹,机器人目标被更新到30赫兹. 模拟暂停同时一个模型计算,因此任务最后期限在模拟时间和成本中以墙上小时来测量. 每个任务都由一个规格来定义,该规格可以固定场景,对象和机制,每个级别参数,剧集随机化和评审. 改变关卡或种子只改变这些参数,从不改变目标或评分规则.

blocks.en: A.2 Assets and Parallel Evaluation
blocks.zh: A.2 资产和平行评价

blocks.en: As shown in Fig. 6 , task scenes combine shared robot and workspace assets with task-specific objects, instruments, and mechanisms. Their geometry, motion, and contact properties are configured so that every required effect is physically realized: a button travels and releases, a dial retains its reading after release, cloth stays folded only if it is laid flat, and a balance beam deflects under the actual load. Physical completion checks compare simulator states and events with task requirements, including release and support after placement.
blocks.zh: 如图6所示,任务场景将共享的机器人和工作空间资产与特定任务对象,仪器和机制相融合. 它们的几何,运动,和接触特性都进行了配置,以便实际实现所有所需的效果:一个按钮出行并放出,一个拨号在放出后保留其读取功能,布被平放后才能被折叠,而平衡梁在实际负载下会偏移. 物理完成检查将模拟状态和事件与任务要求进行比较,包括安置后释放和支持.

blocks.en: Episodes run in isolated simulator processes. A scheduler distributes task-level conditions across the available GPUs and checks the first result of each condition before launching its remaining seeds. A valid policy failure lets evaluation continue, whereas a runtime failure blocks the remaining seeds for inspection. Model services may persist across episodes, and requests from concurrent episodes are kept apart, so that each episode observes its own visual-action sequence.
blocks.zh: Episode运行于孤立的模拟过程. 排程器在可用的GPU中分配任务级别条件,并在发射所剩种子之前检查每个条件的第一个结果. 有效的政策失败使评价得以继续,而运行时间失败则会阻碍剩余的种子进行检查。 样板服务可能持续跨出各集,同时出演各集的请求被分开,以便每集都遵守自己的视觉动作序列.

blocks.en: A.3 Demonstration Collection
blocks.zh: A.3 示范收集

blocks.en: Demonstrations are collected under one protocol for every task and level: 50 episodes per task and level for all thirty tasks (4,500 in total), all recorded in Clean scenes. Each episode records the instruction, three RGB streams at 30 Hz, and the joint states, with joint targets logged at 120 Hz. A demonstration qualifies only if the evaluator marks it successful. For timing-critical tasks it must also keep a margin, for example at least 1 s between withdrawal and gate closure in DR3. Experts are scripted: task scripts set the operation sequence and end-effector targets, and inverse kinematics and motion planning produce the joint trajectories (Section 3.4.1 ). Recording checks identify missing or corrupted frames, invalid state or action values, misaligned timestamps, and duplicate recordings. Together with the physical completion checks, they ensure that demonstrations show the required behavior and yield consistent training records.
blocks.zh: 每个任务和级别都根据一个协议收集演示:每个任务50集,所有30个任务(共4,500个),全部记录在"清洁场景"中. 每集记录指令,30赫兹的三条RGB流和联合州,联合目标记录为120赫兹. 只有在评价人员标记成功时,演示才有资格。 对于时间紧迫的任务,它也必须保持一定的幅度,例如在DR3中撤离和关闸之间至少1分。 专家被编为脚本:任务脚本设定了操作序列和最终效果目标,反向动能和运动规划产生联合出轨(第3.4.1节. 记录检查识别缺失或损坏的帧,无效状态或动作值,错配时间戳,并重复录音. 在进行实际完成检查的同时,他们确保示威显示必要的行为并产生一致的培训记录。

blocks.en: Figure 11 : Demonstration collection and quality control. A scripted expert executes each task instance at 120 Hz while the robot state, contacts and camera readbacks are logged on every physics tick. An episode is kept only if the test-time scorer gives it full score, timing-critical tasks keep the required margin, the arms make no self- or cross-arm contact, and the recording is gap-free and clock-aligned. Otherwise it is discarded and collected again. Kept episodes are stored as 30 Hz HDF5 files.

blocks.en: A.4 Instance Generation: Clean and Random Settings
blocks.zh: A.4 实例生成:清洁和随机设置

blocks.en: Every task and level has a frozen set of 50 evaluation slots, and each slot can be run in two settings that share the task instance and differ only in the scene around it. Each setting counts as a separate configuration, so the thirty tasks, three levels and two settings give the 180 configurations of the benchmark. Evaluation seeds are not used for training.
blocks.zh: 每个任务和关卡都有一组被冻结的50个评价档,每个档次可以在两个共享任务实例的场合运行,并且只在周围的场景中有所不同. 每个设置都算作一个单独的配置,所以三十个任务,三个级别和两个设置都给出了基准的180个配置. 评价种子不用于培训。

blocks.en: The slot’s task seed draws the task-relevant parameters described in Section 3.5.1 : object layouts, initial and target states, event orders and hidden parameters such as the PR5 stamp angle. Appearance is fixed to the default scene, with its table and floor materials and lighting, and no unrelated objects are present.
blocks.zh: 该槽的任务种子绘制出3.5.1节所描述的任务相关参数:对象布局,初始和目标状态,事件命令和隐藏参数,如PR5印花角. 外观被固定到默认的场景上,有它的桌子和地板材料以及照明,没有不相干的物品存在.

blocks.en: The same slot keeps its task seed, so objects, targets and events are identical to the clean instance. A separate environment seed adds three kinds of scene perturbation. (i) Clutter objects are drawn from a shared library and placed on free table space, and their poses are recorded after they settle under physics. (ii) Table and floor materials are drawn from a texture library. (iii) The light type is drawn from six (dome, rectangular, distant, sphere, cylinder, disk), its intensity is scaled by 0.8–1.2, and each RGB channel is scaled by 0–2. The amount of clutter is set per task and, for most tasks, does not change with the difficulty level. Clutter is placed only on free table space, never on a conveyor belt. The Random scene of a slot is fixed, so systems run on the same slot start from the same scene.
blocks.zh: 同一个槽保留着它的任务种子,所以对象,目标和事件都与干净的例子完全相同. 单独的环境种子增加了三种场景扰动. (一) Clutter对象取自共享库并放入自由桌空间,其姿势在物理下和解后被记录. (二)表层材料取自纹理库. (三)光线型由6个(dome,矩形,远地,球体,圆筒,磁盘)所取出,其强度被缩放0.8–1.2,每个RGB信道被缩放0–2. 拼接量被设定为每个任务,对于大多数任务,不会随难度水平而变化. 克拉夫特只被放在免费的桌子上,从未被放在传送带上. 一个槽的随机场景是固定的,所以在同一槽上运行的系统是从同一个场景开始的.

blocks.en: Fig. 4 gives examples of the two settings. All nine evaluated systems cover all thirty tasks in both settings. Reproducing a result requires the setting as well as the instance identifier.
blocks.zh: 图4举例说明了这两种设置。 所有九个受评价的系统都涵盖两个环境的所有30个任务。 复制结果需要设置和实例标识符。

blocks.en: Appendix B Evaluation Protocol Details
blocks.zh: 附录B 评价议定书

blocks.en: With the scenes and test instances fixed by Appendix A , this appendix specifies how a system interacts with them, expanding Section 4 : what it observes and how it acts, how long an episode may run, how the episode is scored, and how results are selected.
blocks.zh: 随着附录A所固定的场景和测试实例,本附录规定了一个系统如何与它们互动,扩展了第4节:它观察到什么以及它如何行动,一个剧集可以运行多久,剧集如何得分,以及如何选择结果.

blocks.en: B.1 Observations, Actions and Hidden State
blocks.zh: B.1 观察、行动和隐藏状态

blocks.en: A policy receives the task instruction, the selected RGB cameras with arm joint positions and the declared gripper state, and earlier public observations and permitted feedback. Hidden task state is excluded, including unannounced targets and tolerances such as the PR5 angle, the DR3 gate timing and the DR4 drift radius. The evaluator uses it only to check contact, support, timing and completion.
blocks.zh: 一项政策收到任务指示,选定的RGB相机带有臂联位置和宣布的抓取状态,以及早期的公众观察和允许反馈. 隐藏的任务状态被排除在外,包括未宣布的目标和耐受性,如PR5角度,DR3门计时和DR4漂移半径等. 评价人员只用它来检查联系、支持、时间安排和完成情况。

blocks.en: End-to-end policies predict joint or end-effector actions. Joint predictions are denormalized and relative offsets converted to absolute targets. Cartesian poses are transformed into the controller frame and mapped to joint targets by inverse kinematics. Each policy executes its configured chunk before predicting again. Agents instead select Cartesian targets through motion tools, which a local inverse-kinematics and motion-planning service turns into trajectories using declared robot and fixed-scene geometry. Depth and pixel-to-world queries are disabled, and agents may retrieve earlier public images without advancing the simulation. The planner, history access and any adapter fallback are therefore part of the evaluated system (Table 9 ).
blocks.zh: 端到端政策预测联合或最终效应行动. 联合预测是非正常的,相对抵消转换为绝对目标. 笛卡尔外形被转化为控制器框架并被反相动能映射到联合目标上. 每个策略在再次预测前都会执行所配置的块 。 代理通过运动工具选择笛卡尔目标,而本地反相和运动规划服务则会使用已申报的机器人和固定相片几何转换为轨迹. 深度和像素到世界的查询被禁用,代理商可能在不推进模拟的情况下检索更早的公共图像. 因此,规划员、历史访问和任何适配器的回落都是评估系统的一部分(表9)。

blocks.en: Table 9: System interfaces. What each system family receives and returns under the shared protocol.
blocks.zh: 表9:系统接口. 根据共享协议,每个系统家族都收到和返回什么。

blocks.en: B.2 Horizons and Budgets
blocks.zh: B.2 地平线和预算

blocks.en: The end-to-end task horizon uses the 90th percentile of demonstration duration at each level, multiplied by 1.2 and rounded up to a control step. Clean and Random share it. Agents use this physics budget multiplied by four and at most 150 decisions per episode (Table 10 ). Rejected and invalid actions count as decisions. Network retries do not, with up to 12 retries per decision. An agent episode ends when the task is complete, when the agent stops, or when either budget is used. Wall-clock limits are safety stops. An episode stopped by one is scored like any other unfinished episode.
blocks.zh: 端到端任务视野采用每个级别演示时间的90%,乘以1.2并四舍五入到一个控制步骤. 干净和随机分享。 代理人使用这一物理预算乘以每集最多150个决定(表10)。 驳回和无效的行动算作决定。 网络重试没有,每个决定最多重试12次. 当任务完成时,当代理停止时,或者当使用预算时,代理插曲结束. 墙上的限制是安全站。 被一集阻止的一集 得分与其他未完成的一集一样

blocks.en: Table 10: Run budgets. B B denotes the task- and level-specific end-to-end budget in physics steps.
blocks.zh: 表10:运行预算。 B指物理步骤中的任务和级别特定的端到端预算.

blocks.en: B.3 Task Score
blocks.zh: B.3 任务得分

blocks.en: The task evaluator produces a score between 0 and 100 using the task-specific rule shown on the task pages of the project website. A successful episode scores 100. Any other outcome receives the partial credit defined for that task, or zero. For example, CP01 gives credit for each requested item released into the correct tray and remaining supported, and full success additionally requires every order to be complete and the meal trays to be retrieved. Partial-credit scales differ between tasks, so scores are compared across systems on one task and averaged within a view, but not compared across tasks.
blocks.zh: 任务评价员使用项目网站任务页面上显示的任务特定规则,得出0至100分的分数. 成功的一集得分100分. 任何其他结果都得到为该任务规定的部分信用或零。 例如,CP01为每个被请求的被放入正确托盘并仍然被支持的物品提供功劳,而完全成功还需要每个顺序完成并取回餐盘. 部分信用等级因任务不同而不同,因此各系统在一个任务上进行分数比较,并在视野内进行平均,但不在任务间进行比较.

blocks.en: For each task, the evaluator marks an episode as successful when it meets all completion criteria, satisfies any prerequisites, and violates no rule that prevents success. We calculate each system’s success rate by dividing the number of episodes marked as successful by the total number of evaluated episodes.
blocks.zh: 对于每项任务,评估人员在达到所有完成标准、满足任何先决条件以及不违反任何妨碍成功的规则时,将某一事件标为成功。 我们计算每个系统的成功率的方法是,除以被评为成功的剧集总数。

blocks.en: B.4 Evaluation Integrity and Result Selection
blocks.zh: B.4 评价廉正和成果选择

blocks.en: Every system on a leaderboard receives the same frozen list of task, level and seed instances. Reset restores the robot, objects, task stage, evaluator and random state, and clears policy memory. Each episode writes a manifest that binds the task, level, seed and configuration hashes to the observation profile, action interface, model or checkpoint version, clocks, budgets, termination reason and scorer output, together with an event record that separates the issued action from the evaluator’s completion check. All evaluations in this report were run by the benchmark team on its own machines.
blocks.zh: 领导板上的每个系统都收到相同的被冻结的任务、级别和种子实例清单。 重置恢复了机器人,对象,任务阶段,评估者和随机状态,并清除了政策记忆. 每集都会写一份清单,将任务,级别,种子和配置散列与观察剖面,动作界面,模型或检查点版本,时钟,预算,终止理由和计分器输出相接,同时附上一个事件记录,将发布的动作与评估者完成检查分开. 本报告的所有评价均由基准小组自行进行。

blocks.en: Each system receives one result per test instance and scene setting. Infrastructure failures can trigger a retry. A valid run in which the policy fails the task still counts as a failure. Earlier attempts may remain in the logs for cost tracking, but each retained result counts only once.
blocks.zh: 每个系统每个测试实例和场景设置都得到一个结果. 基础设施的故障可能引发重试。 保险单失败的有效运行仍然算作失败。 较早的尝试可能仍留在成本跟踪记录中,但每次保留的结果只算一次。

blocks.en: This appendix defines the diagnostic steps and failure codes used in Section 6 , gives the task-level results behind the per-view discussion, lists what each diagnosis layer settles for the three diagnosed systems, gives the model profile cards of three representative systems and the stop reasons of the agent episodes, and closes with the behavioral profiles.

blocks.en: E.1 Diagnostic Steps and Failure Codes
blocks.zh: E.1 诊断步骤和失败守则

blocks.en: For each failed episode, we look for the first error from which the system could no longer recover. An error that the system later corrects does not count. We assign the failure to the earliest stage that explains the observed outcome. For example, choosing the wrong object to grasp is a reasoning error. Choosing the correct object but failing to hold it is an execution error.
blocks.zh: 对于每一个失败的插曲,我们寻找第一个系统无法再恢复的错误. 系统后来纠正的错误不计数 。 我们把失败归咎于最早的阶段,这解释了观察到的结果。 例如,选择错误的对象来抓取是一个推理错误. 选择正确的对象但未能持有它是一个执行错误 。

blocks.en: We defined the failure codes by mapping the steps of each of the 30 tasks and identifying what could go wrong at each step. Table 15 lists the resulting 21 codes. Eighteen describe failures in four stages: perceiving the scene and reasoning about the next action (Mind), executing the action (Act), and checking its physical outcome to decide what to do next (Mind-Action composition). The remaining three codes apply to the episode as a whole: the system exhausts its physics or decision budget, stalls or repeats an action, or leaves too little evidence to identify the failure. These codes are not assigned to a side. Each task uses only the codes relevant to its steps. The side of a failure (Mind, Act or composition) follows from its stage, whatever the view of the task. A misread cue in an Act task counts as a Mind failure. The assignment is a classification of the first unrecoverable error and is not a causal test.
blocks.zh: 我们通过绘制30个任务中的每一个步骤来定义故障代码,并找出每个步骤中可能出现的错误。 表15列出了由此产生的21个代码。 18描述了四个阶段的失败:了解场景和对下个动作的推理(Mind),执行动作(Act)并检查其实际结果以决定下一步要做什么(Mind-Action community). 其余三个代码适用于整个剧集:系统耗尽物理或决策预算,拖延或重复动作,或留下太多证据来识别失败. 这些代码没有分配到一边. 每个任务只使用与其步骤相关的代码. 失败的一面(思想、行为或构成)从阶段开始,无论任务如何。 Act任务中的误读提示算作"心灵失败". 转让是对第一个无法恢复的错误的分类,不是因果检验.

blocks.en: E.2 Task-Level Results by View
blocks.zh: E.2 按视图划分的任务级结果

blocks.en: This section gives the task-level success counts behind the per-view discussion of Section 5.2 .
blocks.zh: 本节说明第5.2节的逐一讨论背后的任务层面成功情况。

blocks.en: For three of the four VLAs, one task, passing through gates that open and close on a cycle (DR3), accounts for 36–41% of all successes: 238 of 628 for KinRT, 236 of 574 for π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} and 227 of 626 for X-VLA. For X-VLA, three tasks (DR3, cloth folding PR4 and resistance adjustment PR1) account for 549 of its 626 successes. Gemini-4-Argon shows the same pattern on a smaller scale: resistance adjustment and gate passage together contribute 24 of its 42 successes.
blocks.zh: 对于四个VLA中的三个,一个任务是通过一个周期(DR3)打开和关闭的大门,占所有成功率的36-41%:KinRT为628分中的238分,574分中的236分为0.5分==================;X-VLA为626分中的227分. 对于X-VLA,3项任务(DR3,布料折叠PR4和阻力调整PR1)占其626项成功中549项. 双子座-4-Argon在更小的尺度上显示出同样的模式:阻力调整和门通共同贡献了它的42个成功中的24个.

blocks.en: Workpiece tracking (M1), tray carrying with loose balls (DR4), oriented stamping (PR5), the domino chain (PR6), moving-rack loading (CP03), temperature-controlled cooking (CP04), bridge building (CP07) and whiteboard restoration (CP09) have no successful episode among the 56,700. On four of them (DR4, PR6, CP07 and CP09), every system also has a mean task score of zero, meaning that not even the first scored stage is reached. Each of these tasks has fifty scripted demonstrations per level that pass the same evaluator, confirming platform feasibility.
blocks.zh: 工作台跟踪(M1),托盘上携带松散球(DR4),取向印花(PR5),多米诺链(PR6),起动架装入(CP03),温度控制烹饪(CP04),桥牌楼(CP07)和白板修复(CP09)等56,700人中没有成功的插曲. 在其中的4个(DR4,PR6,CP07和CP09)上,每个系统也有一个平均任务分为零,这意味着连第一个得分的阶段都没有达到. 其中每一项任务每个级别都有50个脚本演示,通过同一评价员,确认平台可行性.

blocks.en: Mind
blocks.zh: 当心

blocks.en: The VLAs complete few Mind episodes, and their successes are concentrated in a narrow set of tasks. KinRT’s 132 Mind successes include 46 on steamer-stack restoration (P2), 22 on card matching (M2), and 20 on repeated-item recognition (E1). Of the 105 successes of π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} , 43 are on P2 and 22 on hazard navigation (S2). These successes occur mostly at the Easy level, where the least information must be retained (Table 14 for π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} and G0.5), and mostly in Clean scenes (Section 5.2 ). Across the four VLAs, workpiece tracking (M1) is never completed and tray-layout restoration (S1) only once. A policy that conditions on the current observation or on a short history cannot recover information that has left its view, and the Mind results of the VLAs are consistent with this limitation. Evaluating memory-augmented policies [ 29 , 30 , 56 ] on the Mind view provides a direct test.
blocks.zh: 志愿军完成的Mind剧集不多,他们的成功集中在一套狭窄的任务上. KinRT的132个思维成功包括46个蒸汽机-塑料还原(P2),22个卡匹配(M2)和20个重复项目识别(E1). 在105项成功事例中,有43项是P2,22项是危险航行(S2)。 这些成功大多发生在易事层面,其中必须保留最少的信息(表14, ^ 0.5\pi_{0.5}和G0.5),大多发生在清洁场景(第5.2节)。 在四个VLA中,工作台跟踪(M1)从未完成,托盘放出修复(S1)只完成一次. 以当前观察或短暂历史为条件的政策无法取回其观点所留下的信息,而VLA的Mind结果也符合这一限制. 在Mind观点上评价记忆强化政策[29,30,56]提供了一个直接的测试.

blocks.en: GPT-6 Astra succeeds in 52.7% of Mind episodes, but its performance is uneven within three of the five categories: 100% on hazard navigation (S2) against 23.3% on tray-layout restoration (S1), 93.3% on card matching (M2) against 0% on workpiece tracking (M1), and 43.3% on meal orders (P1) against 0% on steamer-stack restoration (P2). The tasks it solves best are those in which the action is a button press or a simple placement (S2, F1, M2, E2, E1), whereas the tasks it fails additionally require lifting covers, routing a workpiece through stations, or unstacking and restacking baskets. Its Mind score therefore reflects the reach of its motion tools as well as its memory, and because each category contains only two tasks, category-level differences should not be read as differences between kinds of memory. DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash shows the same pattern on a smaller scale: its 33 Mind successes all come from five of these tasks (M2 10, E1 6, E2 6, S2 6 and F1 5). Gemini-4-Argon obtains its 13 on six tasks.
blocks.zh: GPT-6 Astra在52.7%的Mind分出中成功,但其性能在五类中的三类中不均匀:危险导航(S2)为100%;托盘铺设恢复(S1)为23.3%;卡片配对(M2)为93.3%;工作台跟踪(M1)为0%;餐单(P1)为43.3%;蒸汽机-塑料恢复(P2)为0%。 它最能解决的任务是动作是按下按钮或简单放置(S2,F1,M2,E2,E1)的任务,而它未能完成的任务则额外需要取出封面,通过站台引导一个工作员,或者不打包和再打包篮子. 因此,它的Mind分数反映了其运动工具的能及内存,并且由于每个类别只包含两个任务,所以类别级别差异不应被理解为各类内存之间的差异. DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash在较小的尺度上显示了同样的模式:其33 其中五项任务(M2 10、E1 6、E2 6、S2 6和F1 5)是心灵的成功。 双子座4-Argon在6个任务上获得了13个.

blocks.en: Act
blocks.zh: 行为

blocks.en: Act is the view in which the VLAs succeed most often, and their success comes mainly from dynamic response. Averaged over tasks, the four VLAs reach 22–28% on the four dynamic tasks and 4–18% on the six precision tasks. Although they are trained on the same demonstration collection, the policies differ sharply from task to task, and no single policy leads throughout: G0.5 leads on DR1 and DR2, KinRT on DR3, and X-VLA on PR1 and PR4. G0.5 leads light-cued response (DR2, 110 of 300 episodes) but is last on resistance adjustment (PR1, 9), where X-VLA leads with 130. X-VLA also completes 192 cloth-folding episodes (PR4), against 30 to 54 for the other three. Apart from the zero-success tasks DR4, PR5 and PR6, pen tracing (PR3) is completed only three times in 1,200 VLA episodes.

blocks.en: GPT-6 Astra completes every resistance-adjustment episode and most episodes of the three timed tasks DR1, DR2, and DR3 (76.7%, 90.0%, and 80.0%), yet it completes no episode of the five tasks that require continuous contact or a carried load (DR4, PR3, PR4, PR5, and PR6). The Hard level of DR2 allows 2.6 s to press a lit button, whereas the agent’s mean request time on Act tasks is 9.2 s. Because simulation pauses during inference, the agent can still meet the deadline. These results show that the agent selects and times actions correctly in simulation time. blocks.zh: GPT-6 Astra完成3个定时任务的DR1,DR2和DR3(76.7%,90.0%和80.0%)的每集抵抗调整分集和大部分分集,然而它没有完成需要连续接触或载荷的5个分集(DR4,PR3,PR4,PR5和PR6). DR2的硬度允许2.6s按下一个点亮的按钮,而代理商对Act任务的平均请求时间为9.2s. 因为模拟在推论期间会暂停,所以代理机仍然可以达到最后期限. 这些结果显示,代理在模拟时间中选择和时间动作正确. 他们不测试实时反应。

blocks.en: Mind2Act
blocks.zh: 思维2法案

blocks.zh: 表16按任务列出了每个系统已完成的Mind2Act事件。

blocks.en: GPT-6 Astra succeeds in 52.7% of Mind and 39.0% of Act episodes. If a Mind2Act workflow required one independent success of each kind, 20.5% of its Mind2Act episodes would succeed. It completes only 12.0% (36 of 300, 95% Wilson interval [8.8, 16.2]%). Eighteen of the 36 successes come from conveyor meal assembly (CP01), and it completes none of CP03, CP04, CP07, CP09 or CP10. The two weaker agents complete no Mind2Act episode, which gives a 95% Wilson interval of [0, 1.3]% for each of their success rates.
blocks.zh: GPT-6 Astra在Mind的52.7%和Act的39.0%的节目中成功. 如果Mind2Act工作流程需要一种独立的成功,那么其Mind2Act的20.5%的出场次数将会成功. 它只完成了12.0%(300分之36, 95%的威尔逊间隔[8.8, 16.2%]). 36个成功中,有18个来自传送用餐组装(CP01),没有完成CP03,CP04,CP07,CP09或CP10. 两个较弱的特工完成了没有"Mind2Act"的插曲,这使得威尔逊的间隔为95%,每集成功率为[0, 1.3%].

blocks.en: The VLAs complete 0.2–3.6% of Mind2Act episodes, close to their Mind success rates (1.0–4.4%) and far below their Act rates. For KinRT, π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} and G0.5, the Mind2Act rate exceeds the product of the Mind and Act rates (for example, 3.6% against 0.4% for π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} ), and for X-VLA the two are about equal (0.2%). This reflects concentration: produce weighing (CP06) and conveyor meal assembly (CP01) supply 75 of KinRT’s 88 Mind2Act successes, 88 of the 109 of π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} , and 61 of the 69 of G0.5, mostly at the Easy level. At Easy, CP01 has a single order and CP06 a single item to weigh, so little must be remembered and a practiced motion carries most of the task. For these policies, the two workflows then behave much like Act tasks. InternW0 departs from this pattern: block structure from a shown blueprint (CP08) contributes 35 of its 91 Mind2Act successes, more than any other end-to-end policy completes on that task, while produce weighing (CP06) contributes 48.
blocks.zh: 志愿军完成0.2-3.6%的Mind2 行为率,接近其智力成功率(1.0-4.4%)并远低于其行为率。 对KinRT, ^ 0.5\pi_{0.5}和G0.5来说,Mind2Act率超过了Mind和Act率的产值(例如,3.6%对0.4%= 0.5\pi_{0.5}),对X-VLA来说,两者大约相等(0.2%)。 这反映了集中程度:生产量重(CP06)和传送器用餐组装(CP01)提供了KinRT的88 Mind2Act的75个成功成绩,其中88个为0.5\pi=0.5}的109个成功成绩,61个为G0.5的69个成功成绩,大多在易行一级。 在Easy,CP01有一个单个顺序和CP06一个单个项来重量,因此很少必须记住,实践的运动承担了大部分任务. 对于这些政策来说,两个工作流程的行为与Act任务大相径庭. InternW0偏离了这种模式:块状结构与已显示的蓝图(CP08)相比,它为91项Mind2Act的成功贡献了35项,比完成这项任务的任何其他端到端政策贡献了更多,而产量(CP06)则贡献了48项。

blocks.en: On the four workflows that no system completes (CP03, CP04, CP07 and CP09), the mean task score of every system is at most 1.2 points out of 100. The profile card of G0.5 (Fig. 12 ) shows why for one policy: 202 of its 300 bridge-building episodes (CP07) never grasp a piece. Elsewhere, partial credit adds little. For every system, the Mind2Act score exceeds the success rate by at most 1.5 points, so under the current scoring rules a failed Mind2Act episode has usually failed early rather than near completion. For most systems evaluated here, these four workflows therefore end at the first physical step, before the composition they were designed to test. InternW0 on cooking (CP04) is the exception: in 271 of its 300 episodes it switches on the heat before all ingredients are in the pot, which is a composition error.
blocks.zh: 关于没有系统完成的四个工作流程(CP03,CP04,CP07和CP09),每个系统的平均任务分最高为100分中的1.2分. G0.5(图12)的剖面卡显示为何一项政策:其300个桥建事件(CP07)中的202个从未抓住一分. 在其他地方,部分信贷增加不多。 对于每个系统,Mind2Act的分数在最多1.5分时都超过了成功率,因此根据目前的分数规则,一个失败了的Mind2Act一集通常提前而不是接近完成. 因此,对于这里评价的大多数系统来说,这四个工作流程在设计用于测试的构成之前,首先在物理阶段结束。 烹饪(CP04)的实习生W0是例外:在其300集中的271集中,在将所有成分放入锅中之前会切换出热量,这是一个成分错误.

blocks.en: Conveyor meal assembly (CP01) reuses the conveyor interception of DR1 and, like P1, depends on remembered food orders. Yet GPT-6 Astra completes CP01 more often (60.0%) than P1 (43.3%), and every VLA that completes any CP01 episode does so more often than the product of its P1 and DR1 rates would predict (8.0% for KinRT against 0.1%). A Mind2Act task is thus not simply the conjunction of two single-view tasks, and a lower Mind2Act score cannot by itself be attributed to composition. The views instead show a narrower finding: each system’s ability is uneven across Mind and Act, the systems differ in which is weaker, and every system succeeds less often on the Mind2Act workflows than on its stronger single view.
blocks.zh: 收发机用餐组装(CP01)再用DR1的传送器截取,并和P1一样,依赖于记忆中的食物订单. 然而,GPT-6 Astra完成CP01的频率(60.0%)比P1(43.3%)多,完成任何CP01插曲的每个VLA完成的频率都比其P1和DR1率的产品预测的要多(KinRT为8.0%而0.1%). 思维2 因此,行为任务不仅仅是两个单视图任务的结合,更低的Mind2Act分数本身不能归因于组成. 相反,这些观点显示一个更狭隘的发现:每个系统的能力在Mind和Act之间是不均衡的,而不同的系统则较弱,每个系统在Mind2Act工作流程上的成功频率低于其更强的单一观点。

blocks.en: The two end-to-end policies share a profile but break in different ways. G0.5 most often fails to grasp or hold an object (1,324 episodes) and stalls in 866 episodes. In repeated-item recognition (E1), 250 of its 300 episodes stop before the batch is submitted. InternW0 stalls less, but in 761 episodes it proceeds before a precondition holds: in 271 of its 300 cooking episodes (CP04), it switches on the heat before all recipe ingredients are in the pot. Fine-control errors are its most frequent code (1,132 episodes), and it misapplies the keypad rule in 288 of 299 failed episodes of E2. GPT-6 Astra fails mostly on the execution side (55% of its failures, against 30% on the Mind side), led by grasp (120) and fine-control errors (107): every tray-carrying episode (DR4) is lost during the lift, and 21 of 30 domino-chain episodes (PR6) end with pieces knocked over while they are placed. The cards therefore point to different remedies: grasp demonstrations and task-state memory for G0.5, contact-rich demonstrations and precondition checks for InternW0, and finer motion tools with a check-and-retry step before stopping for the agent.
