blocks.en: E.6 Behavioral Profiles, Just for Fun
blocks.zh: E.6 行为简介,只是为了好玩

blocks.en: Each model profile card also carries a four-letter behavioral profile, such as the ENFP of Fig. 9 . It borrows the MBTI format to turn four comparisons of success rates into a code that is easy to remember and share. Each letter asks one MBTI-style question of a robot policy and answers it with two task groups of the benchmark (Table 19 ). The system takes the letter of the group on which it succeeds more often, so every profile has four letters. Where the two rates differ by less than one percentage point (G0.5’s N and P), the card keeps the letter and marks the lean as weak. A profile says how a system tends to succeed and fail, not how well it performs. The numbers behind it are in the quantitative sections of the card.
blocks.zh: 每个模型剖面卡还搭载了四个字母的行为剖面,如"Fig"的ENFP. 9 (中文(简体) ). 它借用MBTI格式,将成功率的4个比较转化为一个易于记住和共享的代码. 每封信都问一个MBTI风格的机器人政策问题,并以基准的两个任务组(表19)来回答. 系统取取它更频繁地所取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取 如果两种率相差不到一个百分点(G0.5的N和P),卡片会保留字母并将精子标记为弱子. 一个简介说,一个系统如何倾向于成功和失败,而不是表现如何。 后面的数字在卡片的定量部分.

blocks.en: Table 19 : Definition of the four profile letters. Each dimension keeps the question that MBTI asks about a person and answers it with two task groups of the benchmark. The system takes the letter of the group on which it does better. Letter 1 compares the two single-capability views, and letters 2–4 each compare two task groups within one view (column Measured on ).
blocks.zh: 表19:四个简介字母的定义。 每个维度都保留了MBTI对一个人提出的问题,并以基准的两个任务组来回答. 系统取其工作较好的组的字母. 字母1比较了两个单能视图,字母2–4各比较了一个视图中的两个任务组(被测量的栏上).

blocks.en: Each MBTI dimension is matched to the closest contrast in the benchmark. For example, extraverts get things done out in the world and introverts think things over, so a policy that does better on Act is an E and one that does better on Mind is an I. The other three letters follow Table 19 in the same way. The information letter uses only entity memory (E1, E2) and spatial memory (S1, S2). The other Mind categories mix several kinds of memory and stay out of the letters.
blocks.zh: 每个MBTI维度都与基准中最接近的对比相匹配. 例如,外向者让世界做事情,内向者思考事情,所以一个在行动上做得更好的政策是E,一个在Mind上做得更好的政策是I. 其他三个字母以同样的方式跟随表19. 信息函只使用实体内存(E1,E2)和空间内存(S1,S2). 其他Mind类混合了几种记忆并远离字母.

blocks.en: Figure 15 : The sixteen behavioral profiles. Each letter keeps the question that MBTI asks about a person (top: energy, information, decisions, lifestyle) and answers it with two task groups of the benchmark. Each letter keeps its color wherever it appears. Letter 1 compares the Act and Mind views, and letters 2–4 each compare two task groups within one view, giving 2 × 2 × 2 × 2 = 16 2\times 2\times 2\times 2=16 profiles. The first and last letters define the four families, and each family box gives a playful reading of its two letters as a strength ( ) and a weak spot ( ). Within a family, rows give the memory letter (S/N) and columns the execution letter (T/F). Codes, nicknames and pixel characters follow the project website.
blocks.zh: 图15:十六个行为简介. 每封信都保留了MBTI就一个人提出的问题(最高:能量,信息,决定,生活方式),并以基准的两个任务组来回答. 每个字母无论出现在何处都保持其颜色. 第1个字母比较了Act和Mind的观点,第2–4个字母比较了一个视图内的两个任务组,给出了2×2×2 2.×2=16 2\times 2\times 2=16个配置. 首字母和后字母定义了这四个家庭,每个家庭盒都给出了对它的两个字母的玩弄解读,作为强 ()和弱 (.). 在家族内部,行会给出内存字母(S/N)并列行会执行字母(T/F). 代码,昵称和像素字符跟随项目网站.

blocks.en: As in MBTI, the first and last letters sort the codes into four families. Feedforward Planners (I ·· J) think more than they do and stick to a plan made in advance. Feedback Adapters (I ·· P) think more than they do and correct course step by step. Procedural Executors (E ·· J) do more than they think and follow a fixed routine. Servo Responders (E ·· P) have steady hands that adjust as the scene changes. The middle letters add the details: what the system remembers better (S or N) and whether its hands are more accurate (T) or more timely (F). Since every end-to-end policy evaluated here succeeds more often on Act than on Mind (Table 4 ), all of them start with E, while GPT-6 Astra starts with I.
blocks.zh: 和MBTI一样,第一个字母和最后一个字母将代码排序为四个家庭. FeedForward Planers(I QQ J)比他们想得更多,并坚持事先制定的计划. 反馈适配器(I QQ P)比它们思考得更多,并一步一步地正确方向. 程序执行者(E QQ J)比他们想象的多,并遵循固定的常规. Servo Responders (E QQ P) 有稳定的手,随着场景的变化而调整. 中间字母添加了细节:系统记忆得更好(S或N),手是否更准确(T)或更及时(F). 由于在这里评价的每一个端到端政策在行动上比在Mind上更经常成功(表4),所以所有政策都以E开头,而GPT-6 Astra则以I开头.

blocks.en: InternW0 is an ENFP , a Goalkeeper among the Servo Responders, and holds all four letters firmly: it succeeds more often on Act than on Mind (17.6% against 5.4%), on spatial than on entity memory (5.3% against 0.2%), on dynamic response than on precise execution (31.8% against 8.1%), and on feedback-driven than on plan-driven workflows (5.6% against 0.5%). G0.5 is an ENFP too, though only just on the memory and lifestyle letters (0.0% against 0.8%, and 2.1% against 2.5%). GPT-6 Astra is an ISFJ , a Dispatcher among the Feedforward Planners: Mind-led (52.7% against 39.0% on Act), better at entity than spatial memory (68.3% against 61.7%), more successful on dynamic response than on precise execution (61.7% against 23.9%, though its F says only that the timed tasks go better than the precision tasks, not that it reacts fast), and better on plan-driven than on feedback-driven workflows (16.0% against 8.0%). In short, the two Goalkeepers do relatively best on dynamic response, and the Dispatcher completes plan-driven workflows twice as often as feedback-driven ones.
blocks.zh: 实习生W0是一个ENFP,是Servo Responders中的守门员,并牢牢地持有所有四个字母:它比Mind(17.6%对5.4%)在行动上更成功,在空间上更胜于实体内存(5.3%,对0.2%)、在动态反应上更胜于精确执行(31.8%对8.1%),在反馈驱动上更胜于计划驱动的工作流程(5.6%对0.5%)。 G0.5也是一种ENFP,不过只是记忆和生活方式字母(0.0 %对0.8%,2.1%对2.5%)。 GPT-6 Astra是一个ISFJ,是FeedForward Planers中的调度员:由Mind牵头(52.7%对39.0%),在实体上优于空间内存(68.3%对61.7%),在动态响应上优于精确执行(61.7%对23.9%,尽管其F只说定时任务比精确任务要好,而不是反应快),在计划驱动上优于反馈驱动的工作流程(16.0%对8.0%)。 简言之,两个守门员在动态响应方面做得相对较好,调度员完成计划驱动的工作流程的次数是反馈驱动的两倍.

blocks.en: Appendix F Task Details
blocks.zh: 附录F 任务细节

blocks.en: This appendix is the reference for the tasks. It explains where they come from, what each one asks, and how it gets harder. Mind tasks emphasize retaining information and selecting actions, Act tasks emphasize physical precision and timely response, and Mind2Act tasks combine remembered or inferred task state with execution outcomes that constrain subsequent actions. Table 20 lists all thirty tasks. Every task has 50 demonstrations per level (4,500 in total) and is covered by all nine evaluated systems (Table 5 ).
blocks.zh: 本附录为任务参考. 它解释了他们从哪里来,每个人问什么,以及它是如何变得更加困难的。 Mind任务强调保留信息和选择行动,Act任务强调物理精度和及时反应,Mind2Act任务将记忆或推断出的任务状态与制约后续行动的执行结果相结合. 表20列出了所有30项任务。 每项任务每级有50个示范(共计4 500个),所有9个评价系统都涵盖其中(表5)。

blocks.en: The three levels describe changes in task demands rather than a calibrated difficulty ranking. Demonstration and evaluation seeds are disjoint. The common observation and scoring protocol in Section 4 applies throughout.

blocks.zh: M1工作台跟踪和路由回放 综合内存 1 2 3 4 指令. 记住目标位置和站点路线. 追踪目标通过封面交换,发现后按顺序通过规定的站点移动. 圆满. 目标检索和初始站台加访问按顺序重新播放,每次放置都放出并稳定(临时台上放置不计). E/M/H4/4/6站台和3/5/7交换台,包括0/1/2交换台与目标无关. 重播需要4/5/6的布置. 中和硬分别包括至少一次和两次重访.

blocks.en: M2 Card-matching game Integrated memory 1 2 3 4 Instruction. Press and release a card’s yellow button to turn it face up, revealing at most two unmatched cards at a time. Matching pictures stay face up; mismatches turn face down automatically. Wait until the flip or pair result finishes before selecting another card. blocks.en: Ten tasks that test timing and precision, with the operation stated in the instruction.
blocks.zh: 10项任务测试时间和精确度,操作在指令中说明.

blocks.en: DR1 Conveyor pickup Dynamic response 1 2 3 4 Instruction. Hard: Pick up all 7 packages on the conveyor belt and place them in the central collection tray. Success. All required packages stably deposited within budget, none missed (a package that leaves the reach region counts as missed). E / M / H. 3/5/7 packages arrive on the conveyor, and all of them must be collected into the central tray.
blocks.zh: DR1接驳器 动态响应 1 2 3 4 指令 难: 在传送带上取出所有7个包裹,放入中央收藏盘. 圆满. 所有所需包件都稳定地存入预算,没有漏掉(离开覆盖区域的包件算不上漏掉)。 E / M / H 3/5/7包裹到达了传送器上,所有包裹都必须被收集到中央托盘上.

blocks.en: DR2 Light-cued response Dynamic response 1 2 3 4 Instruction. Hard: Press the currently illuminated button within 2.6 seconds and release within 1 second. Respond correctly to all 10 cues; never press an unlit button. Success. Ten correct press-release events, each released within 1 s. A repeated cue needs a separate event. E / M / H. Cue-to-press deadlines are 4.0/3.2/2.6 s. Button geometry, ten-cue count and release timing stay fixed.
blocks.zh: DR2轻发反应 动态反应 1 2 3 4 指令. 难: 在2.6秒内按下当前发光的按钮,并在1秒内放出. 正确响应所有 10 个提示; 从不按一个未打开的按钮 。 圆满. 10个正确的新闻发布事件,每个事件在1秒内发布. 重复的提示需要一个单独的事件. E / M / H. Cue-to-press 截止日期为 4.0.3.2/2.6 s. 按键几何,十克计和放出时间保持不变.

blocks.en: DR3 Timed passage through cyclic gates Dynamic response 1 2 3 4 Instruction. Hard: Grasp the eraser, time the moving gates, and pass through the blue then the orange opening to place the eraser stably in the green tray behind them. Withdraw the whole gripper past the outer gate before they close. Do not touch any gate, frame or rail. Success. The eraser is carried through each open gate in order and left supported in the tray. Dropping or throwing it into the tray earns only the gate-passage credit. When a gate first closes after the eraser has passed, both arms must be clear of its passage on the near side (arm contact with a gate, frame or rail during that closure precludes success). E / M / H. One gate fully open for 6.6/6.0 s per 11.2/10.6 s cycle on Easy/Medium; on Hard, two gates with 18.4 s and 9.2 s cycles whose shared openings alternate between 3.6 s, too short for the measured 5.1 s action chain, and 6.4 s.
blocks.zh: DR3定时通过循环门 动态响应 1 2 3 4 指令. 难: 将擦拭器刺入后方的绿色托盘中。 在门关上之前 将整个抓手撤出 不要碰任何大门、框架或铁路。 圆满. 擦拭器按顺序通过每个开口门,并在托盘中被支持. 扔入或扔入托盘只能赚取出门-过道的信用. 当一扇门在擦拭器过后首次关闭时,两只手臂必须远离其靠近一面的通道(在关闭期间与一扇门、相框或铁路相接则无法成功)。 E / M / H. 一个门完全打开,每11.2/10.6 s 循环在易发/中度;两个门有18.4 s 和9.2 s循环,其共用的开口在3.6 s之间交替开来,对所测量的5.1 s 动作链来说太短了,6.4 s.

blocks.en: DR4 Tray carrying with loose balls Dynamic response (stability) 1 2 3 4 Instruction. Hard: Carry the tray of four balls by its handle from START to DESTINATION around the two staggered columns, keeping each ball inside its marked circle. Set the tray down stably, release it and retreat. Do not touch the balls or hit anything. Success. All balls stay on the tray and inside their circles throughout; tray delivered within 20 mm, vertical error < < 3 mm, released, stable for the last 2 s (a ball leaving its circle, with 0.5 mm tolerance, is a latched failure). E / M / H. 2/3/4 balls, 0/1/2 pillars, and allowed drift radii of 30/25/20 mm.
blocks.zh: 数字 4 托盘携带松散球 动态响应(稳定) 1 2 3 4 指令. 难: 从START到DESTINTION,将四球托盘由手柄托起,绕起两个交错的柱子,将每个球都保留在被标记的圆圈内. 将托盘被刺下,放出后退. 不要碰球或打任何东西。 圆满. 所有球都留在托盘上并在整个圆圈内;托盘在20毫米以内交付,垂直误差 < 3毫米,放出后稳定为后2秒(一球离开其圆圈,可容0.5毫米,是被拉断的故障). E / M / H 2/3/4球,0/1/2柱,并允许30/25/20毫米的漂流光度.

blocks.en: PR1 Resistance adjustment Precise execution 1 2 3 4 Instruction. Adjust the resistance between the left terminal and wiper to R R Ω \Omega , then release the slider and keep that reading for 0.5 seconds. ( R R per episode.) Success. Reading within ± \pm 0.2/0.15/0.12 Ω \Omega , held for 0.5 s after release. E / M / H. One target per episode on a numbered major tick, an unnumbered minor tick, or between minor ticks: 7/21/21 distinct targets, e.g. 10/16/35.75 Ω \Omega .
blocks.zh: PR1 抵抗调整 精准地执行 1 2 3 4 指令. 将左端终端和擦拭器之间的阻力调节到 R 的 complete\ Omega 上,然后释放滑动器,并保持读取0.5秒。 (每集为R. 圆满. 在 &\pm 内阅读 0.2/0.15.0.12 (中文(简体) ). 附加 \ Omega , 释放后为 0. 5 s 。 E / M / H. 每集1个目标在一个编号的主要滴,一个未编号的小滴,或者在小滴之间: 7/21/21 不同的目标,例如: 10/16/35.75 组合\Omega 。

blocks.en: PR2 Voltage setting Precise execution 1 2 3 4 Instruction. Adjust the output voltage to V V V, then release the knob and keep that reading for 1 second. ( V V per episode.) Success. Reading within ± \pm 1/0.5/0.5 V for 1 s after release. E / M / H. One target per episode on a numbered major tick, an unnumbered minor tick, or between minor ticks: 12/33/33 distinct targets, e.g. 160/165/147 V.
blocks.zh: PR2 电压设置 精密执行 1 2 3 4 指令. 将输出电压调整为V V V,然后放出取号并保持读取1秒. (每集五五节. 圆满. ±\pm 1/ 0.5/0.5内读取 V 释放后1 s. E / M / H. 每集1个目标在一个编号的主要滴,一个未编号的小滴,或者在小滴之间: 12/33/33 不同的目标,例如: 五. 导言

blocks.en: PR3 Pen tracing Precise execution 1 2 3 4 Instruction. Grasp the marker and trace the complete visible path, then lift. Success. At least 98% of the reference path lies within 3 mm of ink and the RMS distance from the ink to the path is at most 2 mm. Only ink from actual contact counts. E / M / H. A straight line, an S curve with two half-waves, or a curve with four half-waves. All paths are 350 mm long with ± 3 \pm 3 mm centerline tolerance. Curved paths have minimum radii of about 54/25 mm.
blocks.zh: PR3 笔会追踪精密执行 1 2 3 4 指令. 抓取标记并追踪完整的可见路径,然后抬起. 圆满. 至少98%的参考道位于墨水3毫米以内,而RMS从墨水到道的距离最多为2毫米. 只有实际接触的墨水数。 E / M / H. 直线,由两个半波组成的S曲线,或由四个半波组成的曲线. 所有路径为350毫米长并有±3\pm 3毫米中线耐受性. 曲线道的光度最小为约54/25毫米.

blocks.en: PR4 Cloth folding and flat placement Precise execution 1 2 3 4 Instruction. Hard: Fold the hexagonal cloth once into the displayed trapezoid, align its paired edges, release it fully and leave it stable. Success. Required fold made, layers and corners aligned within tolerance, inside the target frame, released and lying flat and stable. E / M / H. Midline fold into a two-layer rectangle; diagonal fold into a two-layer triangle; a single fold of a hexagon along its symmetry axis into a two-layer trapezoid. All pieces have the same area (400 cm 2 ), mass, and material.
blocks.zh: PR4 克洛斯折叠和平面布置 精准地执行 1 2 3 4 指令. 难: 将六边形的布料倒入已显示的夹层,使其成对的边缘对齐,完全放出并保持平稳. 圆满. 在目标框架内,平平平地放出并平稳地躺下。 E / M / H. 中线折叠为双层矩形;对角折叠为双层三角形;由六边形沿对称轴而成的单相折叠为双层夹角形. 所有棋子有同面积(400厘米2),质量,和材料.

blocks.en: PR5 Oriented stamping Precise execution 1 2 3 4 Instruction. Pick up square stamp A and stamp once, fully inside the blue box, with its arrow aligned to the target arrow. Do not drag or stamp twice. Return the stamp to its holder in its original orientation and release it. Success. Exactly one imprint with all four rotated corners inside the frame and arrow within tolerance, no smear; stamp returned, gripper withdrawn. The arrow defines the orientation over the full 360°. E / M / H. Frames of 100/80/74 mm and orientation tolerances of ± 5 ∘ \pm 5^{\circ} / ± 2 ∘ \pm 2^{\circ} / ± 1 ∘ \pm 1^{\circ} ; targets sampled from 8/32/320 directions; minimum centered margins of 14.6/4.6/1.6 mm.
blocks.zh: PR5 指向印章精密执行 1 二 三 四 指示. 取出正方形的邮票A并印出一次,完全放入蓝盒内,其箭头与目标箭头对齐. 不要拖动或盖章两次。 将印章按原取向还给持章人并放行. 圆满. 只有一个印记,所有四个旋转角在框内,箭在容力内,没有涂抹;印花还原了,抓取了. 箭头定义了整个360°上的方向. E / M / H. 100/80/74毫米框架和取向耐受度为 ± 5 \pm 5\crc / ± 2\pm 2\crc / ± 1\pm 1\crc ;取自 8/32/320取向的目标样本;最小中心边距为 14.6/4.6/1.6毫米.

blocks.en: PR6 Domino chain to a bell Precise execution 1 2 3 4 Instruction. Stand the dominos anywhere inside the continuous curve band, in order along the curve. Push the first one so the chain of contacts rings the bell. Repair fallen or stalled segments using as few pushes as possible. Success. Dominoes released and held in the same valid order for 0.5 s, the first one pushed, and the chain falling along the band to strike the bell. E / M / H. 5/7/9 dominoes; heights of 10.24 (uniform)/8.32–12.00/7.68–13.44 cm; band spans of 41.3/57.3/76.1 cm.
blocks.zh: PR6 多米诺链到一铃 精密执行 1 2 3 4 指令. 在连续曲线带的任何地方立起多米诺斯, 沿曲线排列。 推出第一个 所以联系链响铃。 尽可能少地使用推力来修复掉落或停顿的片段. 圆满. 多米诺斯以0.5 s的同样有效顺序被放出并被扣住,第一个被推倒了,而链条也沿着乐队摔倒来敲钟. E/M/H.5/7/9多米诺斯;高度为10.24(统一)/8.32-12.00/7.68-13.44厘米;波段跨度为41.3/573/76.1厘米。

blocks.en: Mind2Act tasks
blocks.zh: 思维2 行动任务

blocks.en: Ten tasks that combine remembered state and physical outcomes in one loop.
blocks.zh: 将记忆状态和实际结果结合起来的十项任务。

blocks.en: CP01 Conveyor meal assembly Cumulative progress 1 2 3 4 Instruction. At the start, watch the reference meal trays pass on the conveyor and remember the three food types on each. Then prepare the corresponding empty meal trays on the table and fill each with the same three food types from the continuously moving supply. Success. All requested foods stably in the correct meal trays; Medium and Hard also require the meal trays retrieved from the stack (no recirculation or replacement supply). E / M / H. 1/2/3 orders with 3/6/9 food items. Easy provides one meal tray. Medium and Hard require retrieving 2 and 3 meal trays from the left stack, respectively. Belt speed remains 0.025 m/s across all levels.
blocks.zh: CP01 联合国 接线器餐具组装 累计进度 1 2 3 4 指令. 起步时,观看参考餐盘传出传送器,并记住每盘上的三个食物类型. 然后在桌上准备相应的空餐盘,从不断移动的供给中将同一种三种食物相填充. 圆满. 所有要求的食物都用在正确的餐盘上;中和硬也要求从堆栈取回的餐盘(没有回转或替换供应). E/M/H. 1/2/3订单,包含3/6/9食品. 易提供一餐盘. 中和硬分别需要从左堆取出2和3个餐盘. 带速在所有级别上仍为0.025 m/s.

blocks.en: CP02 Rotating-cake decoration Prerequisites and repair 1 2 3 4 Instruction. Hard: Remember each macaron and its place on the still cake shown for three seconds. Open the ingredient-box lid, press the green button and recreate the arrangement as the cake rotates. Then press the red button, wait for the cake to stop, and place the cake cover over it. Success. Full layout placed and all preparation and cleanup steps done; Hard also requires the turntable stopped and at rest before the cover is placed. E / M / H. 4/6/6 macarons at speeds of 12 / 20 / 28 ∘ 12/20/28^{\circ} /s. Easy starts open and running. Medium and Hard add opening the box lid and pressing the green button. Hard also adds the stopping and covering sequence.
blocks.zh: CP02 旋转-蛋糕装饰 须修一一二三四训. 难: 记住每只马卡龙 和它在静态蛋糕上的位置 3秒钟。 打开配料盒盖,按下绿色按钮,并随着蛋糕旋转而再现安排. 然后按下红色按钮,等蛋糕停了再把蛋糕盖上. 圆满. 完全布局布局并完成所有准备和清理步骤; 硬也要求转向台停止并休息后才能放置封面. E / M / H 4/6/6 马卡龙以12 / 20 / 28 + 12/20/28 / s. 易开通并运行. 中和硬加开箱盖并按绿色按钮. 硬还添加了停止和覆盖序列.

blocks.en: CP03 Moving-rack loading Cumulative progress 1 2 3 4 Instruction. Hard: Load 7 upright plates into the moving empty slots without disturbing other plates. Tilt the lever fully toward the back of the machine, away from the robot, release it, then press the green button before loading. Success. Every plate supported by both side supports and the base, earlier plates undisturbed. E / M / H. 3/5/7 plates at 12/16/20 mm/s. All levels start with the green button; Medium first sets the lever upright in the middle, Hard tilts it fully back. Support gaps are approximately 36.5/30.5/26.5 mm. Hard reverses direction with a 0.6 s end transition while insertions occur at cruise speed.
blocks.zh: CP03 移动式车架装载 累计进度 1 2 3 4 指令. 难: 将7个正上方的板块装入移动的空位,而不打扰其他板块. 把杠杆完全向机后倾斜,远离机器人,放出后再按下绿色按钮再装入. 圆满. 每个由两侧支撑和基座支撑的板块,更早的板块没有被扰动. 12/16/20毫米/秒的E / M / H. 3/5/7板. 所有级别都从绿色按钮开始;中度先将杠杆向上向上设置在中间,硬倾斜后完全向后. 支持缺口约为36.5/30.5/26.5毫米. 硬倒向,末端过渡为0.6分,而插入为巡航速度.

blocks.en: CP04 Temperature-controlled cooking Feedback-driven adjustment 1 2 3 4 Instruction. Hard: Open the drawer. Pour each required jar into the pot in the remembered recipe order, returning jars upright and caps to the tray, then cover the pot. Turn the black knob to HEAT and press the green button; within 2 s after 80 °C, switch to KEEP WARM, then press it again. Success. Ingredients added in remembered order before HEAT, KEEP WARM selected within the window before shutdown, and jars and caps returned; Medium and Hard also require the drawer opened and the pot covered. E / M / H. 2/2/3 ordered ingredients from four jars, and HEAT must be switched to KEEP WARM within 4/3/2 s after the pot reaches 80 °C (green band up to 90/87.5/85 °C). All levels return the jars upright and their caps to the tray; Medium and Hard add opening the drawer and covering the pot. Geometric tolerances remain unchanged.
blocks.zh: CP04 温控烹饪回馈驱动调整 1 二 三 四 训导. 难: 打开抽屉 将每个需要的罐子倒入被记住的食谱顺序中,将罐子正上方和瓶盖倒入托盘,再盖上锅. 将黑色旋钮转至HEAT并按下绿色按钮;80°C后2s以内,切换到KEEP WARM,再再再按一次. 圆满. 在HEAT之前按记起的顺序添加了材料,关闭前KEEP WARM在窗口内选择,罐子和盖子还原; 中和硬也要求打开抽屉并覆盖锅. E / M / H 2/2/3从四个罐子中订购了配料,在罐子达到80 °C(绿带可达90/87.5/85 °C)后4/3/2 s以内,HEAT必须切换到KEEP WARM. 所有级别都把罐子倒向正上,把瓶盖放入托盘; 中和硬加开抽屉并盖起锅来. 几何相容度保持不变。

blocks.en: CP05 Piano replay Sequence and plan execution 1 2 3 4 Instruction. Hard: Set volume to MAX and release the slider. Pick up both side mallets, press the triangle-marked button and watch the demonstration while holding both, then reproduce the twelve key presses in order using either mallet. Return and release both mallets, release all keys, withdraw your arms, and keep volume at MAX. Success. Effective strikes in the remembered sequence (rhythm need not match), mallets returned and arms withdrawn; Hard also requires the volume kept at MAX. E / M / H. 7/14/21 candidate keys, 8/8/12 events and 1/2/2 mallets. Easy uses the central mallet; Medium and Hard pick up and return both side mallets together, and Hard also sets the volume slider from MIN to MAX and keeps it there. Either mallet may strike.
blocks.zh: CP05钢琴重放顺序并计划执行 1,2,3,4指令. 难: 将音量设定为 MAX 并释放出滑块 。 取出两个侧面的商场,按下三角标记的按钮,一边看演示,一边抓住两者,再再复制出十二个按键的按键,以便使用任意一个商场. 返回并释放出两块花筒,释放出所有钥匙,取出手臂,并保持体积在MAX. 圆满. 被记住的序列中的有效打击(韵律需要不匹配),回旋回旋和取出武器; Hard还要求将音量保存在MAX. E/M/H. 7/14/21号文件 候选密钥,8/8/12事件和1/2/2大商场。 易用取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取 任何一块大锤都可能撞到

blocks.en: CP06 Produce weighing on a balance Feedback-driven adjustment 1 2 3 4 Instruction. Hard: With the empty scale stable, press ZERO. Move all fruit and vegetables from the left tray onto the left scale pan. Balance the scale using the weights on the right and by physically moving the sliding weight, then release them and keep the pointer in the green zone. Success. All produce on the left pan, the weights needed for balance on the right pan, nothing dropped, and the pointer inside the green zone and stable for 1 s; Medium and Hard also require ZERO pressed on the empty scale, and Hard the sliding weight at its target position. E / M / H. 1/2/3 produce items; Medium and Hard first press ZERO on the empty scale; weight sets of 2 × 50 + 2 × 100 2\times 50{+}2\times 100 g/50–400 g/50–400 g, with a 0–40 g sliding weight added on Hard; green zones of ± 10 \pm 10 / ± 8 \pm 8 / ± 5 \pm 5 g; 9/16/80 candidate states, with a unique solution on Hard.
blocks.zh: CP06 (中文(简体) ). 以反馈驱动的调整衡量平衡情况 1 2 3 4 难: 随着空平平平平稳,按ZERO. 将所有水果和蔬菜从左托盘移到左平面锅上. 用右侧的重量来平衡尺度,通过物理移动滑动重量,然后放出并保持指针在绿地. 圆满. 左锅上的所有出产,右锅上平衡所需要重量,一分不差,绿地内指针并稳定为1 s;中和硬也要求ZERO按空平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平 E / M / H 1/2/3 出产物品; 中和硬先用空尺度按 ZERO; 重量组为 2×50 + 2×100 2\时 50×2\时 100克/50-400克/400克,硬上加有0-40克滑行重量; 绿地区为 ±10\pm 10 / ±8\pm 8 / ±5\pm 5克; 9/16/80 候选状态,硬上加有独有的解决方案.

blocks.en: CP07 Bridge building for a toy car Sequence and plan execution 1 2 3 4 Instruction. Hard: Build a stable bridge across the gap with continuous wheel paths on both sides. Choose suitable pieces by shape and size from the stock, which includes extra blocks, and leave unused blocks aside. Release the bridge pieces, then press and release the button and let the car drive across to the opposite bank. Success. Piers, caps and deck stably in place, button triggered, car upright and across the finish (unused distractor stock allowed). E / M / H. River widths of 18/28/36 cm; 1 pier and 2 spans/2 piers and 3 spans/2 unequal piers, sloped spans, and U-shaped ramp supports; stock of 8/18/28 pieces, of which 8/13/13 are needed.
blocks.zh: CP07 为玩具车搭建的桥梁建筑 序列并计划执行 1 2 3 4 指令. 难: 构筑有两侧连续轮道的横跨缺口的稳定桥梁. 从库存中按形状和大小选择合适的块,包括额外的块,并留下未使用的块. 释放出桥块,然后按下并放出按钮,让汽车驶过对岸. 圆满. 码头、盖子和甲板固定到位,扣子被触发,车体直立并横跨尾部(允许使用未使用的分心器库存)。 E/M/H. 河宽为18/28/36厘米;1个码头和2个跨相/2个码头和3个跨相/2个不平等的码头,坡相,并有U形坡道支撑;有8/18/28个地块,其中需要8/13/13个.

blocks.en: CP08 Block structure from a shown blueprint Prerequisites and repair 1 2 3 4 Instruction. Hard: Remember the briefly shown front view, then build the structure from memory, centred in the marked area and aligned with the table reference line. If the base is misplaced, move the beam above it aside and rebuild; put the roof ridge-up on the cylinders. Use only reference-colour blocks and release everything. Success. Colors, shapes, positions, orientation and support match the blueprint; beam and roof each borne by two blocks; stable 1 s (Hard 5 s) after release (holding the structure up does not count; 90 ∘ 90^{\circ} roof error rejected). E / M / H. 3 cuboids in 2 layers/3 cuboids and 1 cylinder in 3 layers/6 blocks in 4 layers with a prism roof; 0/1/2 distractors; 6/4/4 mm tolerance; 1/1/5 s hold after release.
blocks.zh: CP08 联合国 块状结构来自显示的蓝图 先决条件和修理 1 2 3 4 指令。 难: 记住简短显示的前视线,再从内存中构建出结构,以标记区域为中心并和表格参考行对齐. 如果基座错位了,将上方的梁移出并重建;将屋顶的脊架放入圆柱上. 仅使用参考颜色块并释放出全部. 圆满. 颜色,形状,位置,取向和支持与蓝图相匹配;梁和屋顶各由两个块承接;放出后稳定为 1 s (Hard 5 s) (保持结构上下不计;90 ∘ 90^{\circ}屋顶出错被拒绝). blocks.en: CP09 Whiteboard restoration Prerequisites and repair 1 2 3 4 Instruction. Hard: Remember the briefly shown original drawing on the whiteboard. Erase the added strokes, uncap the pens of the colors needed, and redraw any original strokes you erased, so the board matches the original. Success. Final board matches the original in color, shape and layout: extra strokes removed, over-erased parts redrawn; Medium/Hard include uncapping. E / M / H. 2/3/4 original elements in 1/2/3 colors; added strokes of one line/a long and a short crossing line/two long lines and an extra circle. The board starts on a raised stand; the reference procedure first lays it flat on the table, though only the final board is scored.
blocks.zh: CP09 白板修复 预先要求并修复 1 2 3 4 指令. 难: 记得白板上短暂显示的原画. 切除所添加的中风,解开所需要颜色的笔头,再重新绘制被您抹去的任何原始中风,所以棋盘与原作相匹配. 圆满. 最终棋盘在颜色,形状和布局上与原作相匹配:去除多出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出入出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出 E / M / H 2/3/4 以 1/2/3 为颜色的原始元素;再加一行/一行/一行/一行/一行/一行/两行/一行外加一圈. 棋盘起于起立的摊位;参考程序首先将其平放于桌上,尽管只有最终棋盘得分.

blocks.en: CP10 Return or dodge incoming balls Predictive decision 1 2 3 4 Instruction. Predict each ball from the launcher’s settled aim. After two practice balls, use the sliding blocker to return every white ball to the far net and let every red ball pass untouched into the near net. Wait for each ball to settle before the next shot. Success. Every scored ball correct: white returned to the far net, red cleared into the near net (two practice balls unscored). E / M / H. 5/8/12 scored balls, of which 2/4/6 are red; shots (direct/single-bounce/double-bounce) of 3/2/0 on Easy, 2/4/2 on Medium and 2/5/5 on Hard; countdowns of 4/3/2 s.
blocks.zh: CP10 返回或躲避入球 预测性决定 1 2 3 4 指令。 每个球都从发射筒固定的瞄准点出发。 经过两个练习球后,用滑行阻塞器将每个白球还给远网,并让每个红球顺利地传入近网. 等待每个球在下个镜头前就解决. 圆满. 每入得分球都正确:白回远网,红去入近网(两个练习球没有得分). E/M/H 5/8/12打入分球,其中2/4/6为红色;射入分球(直接/单发/双发)为:Easy上3/2/0分,中分出2/4/2分,硬分出2/5/5分;倒计时为4/3/2分.
